traditional_knowledge: ”A los cultivos perennes y más delicados las aguas más duras no le benefician”. For perennial and more delicate crops, harder water does not benefit them.
quote_es: A los cultivos perennes y más delicados las aguas más duras no le benefician.
quote_en: For perennial and more delicate crops, harder water does not benefit them.
assumption: Harder water can negatively affect perennial and delicate crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los tomates siempre los siembro en luna creciente”. I always plant tomatoes during the crescent moon.
quote_es: Los tomates siempre los siembro en luna creciente.
quote_en: I always plant tomatoes during the crescent moon.
assumption: The phases of the moon affect how crops grow.

traditional_knowledge: ”En el momento del semillado tienes que tener en cuenta la temperatura y cuándo vas a disponer de agua”. At sowing time, you have to consider the temperature and when you will have water available.
quote_es: En el momento del semillado tienes que tener en cuenta la temperatura y cuándo vas a disponer de agua.
quote_en: At sowing time, you have to consider the temperature and when you will have water available.
assumption: Temperature and water availability constrain the seeding time.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los cultivos pueden salir de una forma u otra dependiendo de las propiedades del suelo, por ejemplo: las sandías en terrenos arenosos se ponen más dulces, los melones por el contrario se ’apepinan’ y pierden sabor”. Crops can turn out one way or another depending on soil properties. For example: watermelons become sweeter in sandy soils; melons, on the contrary, become ”cucumber-like” and lose flavor.
quote_es: Los cultivos pueden salir de una forma u otra dependiendo de las propiedades del suelo, por ejemplo: las sandías en terrenos arenosos se ponen más dulces, los melones por el contrario se ’apepinan’ y pierden sabor.
quote_en: Crops can turn out one way or another depending on soil properties. For example: watermelons become sweeter in sandy soils; melons, on the contrary, become ”cucumber-like” and lose flavor.
assumption: Soil properties influence crop development.

traditional_knowledge: ”La cementera es el tiempo en el que se plantan los cereales del invierno, 20 días antes y después de Los Santos (31 Oct) es el momento óptimo para plantarlos”. The ”cementera” is the sowing season for winter cereals, 20 days before and after All Saints’ Day (Oct 31) is the optimal time to plant them.
quote_es: La cementera es el tiempo en el que se plantan los cereales del invierno, 20 días antes y después de Los Santos (31 Oct) es el momento óptimo para plantarlos.
quote_en: The ”cementera” is the sowing season for winter cereals, 20 days before and after All Saints’ Day (Oct 31) is the optimal time to plant them.
assumption: Winter cereals need to be planted according to a specific timetable.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cultivos como berenjena, tomate, pimiento o habas se siembran en luna creciente, mientras que otros como la patata, los ajos, las cebollas o la cebada en luna menguante”. Crops like eggplant, tomato, pepper, or beans are sown during the crescent moon, while others like potatoes, garlic, onions, or barley are sown during the waning moon.
quote_es: Cultivos como berenjena, tomate, pimiento o habas se siembran en luna creciente, mientras que otros como la patata, los ajos, las cebollas o la cebada en luna menguante.
quote_en: Crops like eggplant, tomato, pepper, or beans are sown during the crescent moon, while others like potatoes, garlic, onions, or barley are sown during the waning moon.
assumption: Some crops are sown during the crescent moon, while others are sown during the waning moon.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se nota cuando le falta agua a la planta, se pone lacia, como la dejes dos días más se seca”. You can tell when a plant lacks water; it becomes limp. If you leave it for two more days, it dries out.
quote_es: Se nota cuando le falta agua a la planta, se pone lacia, como la dejes dos días más se seca.
quote_en: You can tell when a plant lacks water; it becomes limp. If you leave it for two more days, it dries out.
assumption: When a plant lacks water, it becomes limp.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para algunos cultivos cuando están naciendo, como el cebollino, al estar tan tiernos les pongo un toldito para protegerlos del sol”. For some crops when they are sprouting, such as chives, since they are so tender, I put up a small awning to protect them from the sun.
quote_es: Para algunos cultivos cuando están naciendo, como el cebollino, al estar tan tiernos les pongo un toldito para protegerlos del sol.
quote_en: For some crops when they are sprouting, such as chives, since they are so tender, I put up a small awning to protect them from the sun.
assumption: Direct sunlight can dry out sprouts.

traditional_knowledge: ”Yo riego cada 8 días. Si algo necesita más agua, lo riego cada 4 días”. I irrigate every 8 days. If something needs more water, I water it every 4 days.
quote_es: Yo riego cada 8 días. Si algo necesita más agua, lo riego cada 4 días.
quote_en: I irrigate every 8 days. If something needs more water, I water it every 4 days.
assumption: Crop water requirements can be solved by shortening the time from one irrigation to another.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para plantar nuevos cultivos me fijo en la temperatura para que no se hielen”. When planting new crops, I pay attention to the temperature so they don’t freeze.
quote_es: Para plantar nuevos cultivos me fijo en la temperatura para que no se hielen.
quote_en: When planting new crops, I pay attention to the temperature so they don’t freeze.
assumption: Extreme freezing temperatures define the sowing calendar.

traditional_knowledge: ”Estamos plantando ahora entre marzo y abril y esperamos que no caigan heladas”. We are planting now between March and April and hope there are no frosts.
quote_es: Estamos plantando ahora entre marzo y abril y esperamos que no caigan heladas.
quote_en: We are planting now between March and April and hope there are no frosts.
assumption: Unexpected frosts can damage or kill sprouts.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los árboles frutales de hoja caduca se pueden transplantar en los meses de frío (noviembre, diciembre, enero) una vez que han perdido las hojas. No importa el frío, como están dormidos”. Deciduous fruit trees can be transplanted during the cold months (November, December, January) once they have lost their leaves. The cold doesn’t matter, as they are dormant.
quote_es: Los árboles frutales de hoja caduca se pueden transplantar en los meses de frío (noviembre, diciembre, enero) una vez que han perdido las hojas. No importa el frío, como están dormidos.
quote_en: Deciduous fruit trees can be transplanted during the cold months (November, December, January) once they have lost their leaves. The cold doesn’t matter, as they are dormant.
assumption: Transplanting fruit trees during dormancy minimizes damage and shock.

traditional_knowledge: ”La planta necesita sed, coge los nutrientes mejor y el desarrollo es mejor”. The plant needs to experience thirst; it absorbs nutrients better and develops better.
quote_es: La planta necesita sed, coge los nutrientes mejor y el desarrollo es mejor.
quote_en: The plant needs to experience thirst; it absorbs nutrients better and develops better.
assumption: Plants benefit from short periods without watering, as this can promote stronger overall development.

traditional_knowledge: ”No es necesario escardar demasiado, la tierra viva es aquella que tiene plantas”. It’s not necessary to weed too much; living soil is that which has plants.
quote_es: No es necesario escardar demasiado, la tierra viva es aquella que tiene plantas.
quote_en: It’s not necessary to weed too much; living soil is that which has plants.
assumption: Soil is alive when it has plants growing in it.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si quieres saber si falta agua en el cultivo tienes que verlo por la mañana”. If you want to know if a crop lacks water, you have to check it in the morning.
quote_es: Si quieres saber si falta agua en el cultivo tienes que verlo por la mañana.
quote_en: If you want to know if a crop lacks water, you have to check it in the morning.
assumption: Water shortage can be tested in the early morning.

traditional_knowledge: ”Algunos cultivos como el pepino, calabacín, judías o las papas necesitan más agua en pleno verano”. Some crops like cucumber, zucchini, beans, or potatoes need more water in the middle of summer.
quote_es: Algunos cultivos como el pepino, calabacín, judías o las papas necesitan más agua en pleno verano.
quote_en: Some crops like cucumber, zucchini, beans, or potatoes need more water in the middle of summer.
assumption: Some crops need more water during the summer season.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay algunas malas hierbas que son indicativo de falta de agua si están lacias”. Some weeds are indicative of water shortage if they are limp.
quote_es: Hay algunas malas hierbas que son indicativo de falta de agua si están lacias.
quote_en: Some weeds are indicative of water shortage if they are limp.
assumption: Weeds can serve as indicators of water deficiency in the soil when they begin to show signs of dryness or stress.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua que recojo de los tejados la almaceno y la uso para regar algunos frutales”. The water I collect from the roofs is stored and I use it to irrigate some fruit trees.
quote_es: El agua que recojo de los tejados la almaceno y la uso para regar algunos frutales.
quote_en: The water I collect from the roofs is stored and I use it to irrigate some fruit trees.
assumption: Water collected from roofs and stored can be used to irrigate.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Algunas malas hierbas que nacen son comestibles, como la verdolaga, los bledos (Amaranthus spp.), los berros de agua (Nasturtium officinale), la borraja (Borago officinalis), las tetillas de vaca o escorzoneras (Scorzonera angustifolia) o la caléndula (Calendula officinalis)”. Some weeds that grow are edible, such as purslane, amaranth, watercress, borage, black salsify, or calendula.
quote_es: Algunas malas hierbas que nacen son comestibles, como la verdolaga, los bledos (Amaranthus spp.), los berros de agua (Nasturtium officinale), la borraja (Borago officinalis), las tetillas de vaca o escorzoneras (Scorzonera angustifolia) o la caléndula (Calendula officinalis).
quote_en: Some weeds that grow are edible, such as purslane, amaranth, watercress, borage, black salsify, or calendula.
assumption: Some weeds that grow in the garden can be consumed.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si las acequias están mal se va perdiendo el agua”. If the ditches are in poor condition, water is lost.
quote_es: Si las acequias están mal se va perdiendo el agua.
quote_en: If the ditches are in poor condition, water is lost.
assumption: Water loss can happen when the irrigation ditches are in poor condition.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Depende del tipo de cultivo y de la experiencia necesitarás más agua o menos”. Depending on the type of crop and experience, you will need more or less water.
quote_es: Depende del tipo de cultivo y de la experiencia necesitarás más agua o menos.
quote_en: Depending on the type of crop and experience, you will need more or less water.
assumption: The type of crop and previous irrigator experience influence the volume of water consumed.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La mejor hora para regar es por la mañana temprano, te levantas descansado y el tiempo está más fresco”. The best time to water is early in the morning; you wake up rested and the weather is cooler.
quote_es: La mejor hora para regar es por la mañana temprano, te levantas descansado y el tiempo está más fresco.
quote_en: The best time to water is early in the morning; you wake up rested and the weather is cooler.
assumption: Lower morning temperatures make irrigation more effective.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El mejor momento para regar es al amanecer o al atardecer, ya no hace tanta calor”. The best time to water is at dawn or dusk, because it is not so hot.
quote_es: El mejor momento para regar es al amanecer o al atardecer, ya no hace tanta calor.
quote_en: The best time to water is at dawn or dusk, because it is not so hot.
assumption: Watering during cooler hours (dawn/dusk) minimizes water loss due to evaporation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La planta te dice cuando le falta agua y le sobra”. The plant tells you when it lacks water and when it has too much.
quote_es: La planta te dice cuando le falta agua y le sobra.
quote_en: The plant tells you when it lacks water and when it has too much.
assumption: Water lack and excess can be visible in the plant.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Con el primer riego de mayo le remuevo mucho la tierra alrededor”. With the first irrigation in May, I turn the soil around it a lot.
quote_es: Con el primer riego de mayo le remuevo mucho la tierra alrededor.
quote_en: With the first irrigation in May, I turn the soil around it a lot.
assumption: Tilling after the first summer season watering is beneficial.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cada vecino utiliza el agua que necesita”. Each neighbor uses the water they need.
quote_es: Cada vecino utiliza el agua que necesita.
quote_en: Each neighbor uses the water they need.
assumption: Each irrigator uses only the amount of water needed.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua sobrante no se desperdicia, vuelve al río”. The leftover water is not wasted; it returns to the river.
quote_es: El agua sobrante no se desperdicia, vuelve al río.
quote_en: The leftover water is not wasted; it returns to the river.
assumption: Remaining irrigation water flows back to the river.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Almaceno agua de la acequia en la alberca para poder regar con presión”. I store the water from the acequia in a pond to be able to water with pressure.
quote_es: Almaceno agua de la acequia en la alberca para poder regar con presión.
quote_en: I store the water from the acequia in a pond to be able to water with pressure.
assumption: Storing water from the ditch in ponds benefits gravity-fed pressure for irrigation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Regar de noche es más incómodo”. Watering at night is more uncomfortable.
quote_es: Regar de noche es más incómodo.
quote_en: Watering at night is more uncomfortable.
assumption: Watering at night is uncomfortable.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las fincas más grandes tienen más horas de riego que las fincas más pequeñas”. Larger properties have more watering hours than smaller properties.
quote_es: Las fincas más grandes tienen más horas de riego que las fincas más pequeñas.
quote_en: Larger properties have more watering hours than smaller properties.
assumption: Irrigation hours depend on the extension of the land owned.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Se avisaba al vecino por cortesía de que ibas a soltar el agua, para que no se desperdiciara”. Neighbors were informed as a courtesy that you were going to release the water, so it wouldn’t be wasted.
quote_es: Se avisaba al vecino por cortesía de que ibas a soltar el agua, para que no se desperdiciara.
quote_en: Neighbors were informed as a courtesy that you were going to release the water, so it wouldn’t be wasted.
assumption: Informing your neighbors that you have finished irrigating helps avoid water loss.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”En invierno normalmente no se regaba, con lo que llovía se sacaba la cosecha”. In winter, they usually didn’t irrigate; with the rainfall, the harvest was obtained.
quote_es: En invierno normalmente no se regaba, con lo que llovía se sacaba la cosecha.
quote_en: In winter, they usually didn’t irrigate; with the rainfall, the harvest was obtained.
assumption: Winter season rainfalls are enough to grow winter crops.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Un exceso de agua puede dar lugar a la aparición de enfermedades”. Excess water can lead to the appearance of diseases.
quote_es: Un exceso de agua puede dar lugar a la aparición de enfermedades.
quote_en: Excess water can lead to the appearance of diseases.
assumption: Excess water can lead to the appearance of diseases.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El sistema de recogida de agua de lluvia me permite emplear ese agua en el riego”. The rainwater harvesting system allows me to use that water for irrigation.
quote_es: El sistema de recogida de agua de lluvia me permite emplear ese agua en el riego.
quote_en: The rainwater harvesting system allows me to use that water for irrigation.
assumption: Collected rainwater can be used to irrigate.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para saber si una planta necesita agua hay que fijarse tanto en la planta como en el suelo”. To know if a plant needs water, you have to look at both the plant and the soil.
quote_es: Para saber si una planta necesita agua hay que fijarse tanto en la planta como en el suelo.
quote_en: To know if a plant needs water, you have to look at both the plant and the soil.
assumption: Plant and soil dryness are indicative of crop water requirement.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua de las albercas no se puede almacenar durante mucho tiempo”. Water from ponds cannot be stored for a long time.
quote_es: El agua de las albercas no se puede almacenar durante mucho tiempo.
quote_en: Water from ponds cannot be stored for a long time.
assumption: Pond water cannot be stored for a long time.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si riegas a manta no puedes regar con un chorrito, porque si no no anda el agua”. If you use flood irrigation, you cannot water with a thin stream, because otherwise the water doesn’t spread.
quote_es: Si riegas a manta no puedes regar con un chorrito, porque si no no anda el agua.
quote_en: If you use flood irrigation, you cannot water with a thin stream, because otherwise the water doesn’t spread.
assumption: Flood irrigation requires a certain stream flow.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si viene un chorro de agua hay que meterla en la alberca porque si no se desaprovecha, así almacenas para que salga con presión”. If a stream of water comes, you have to store it in the pond, otherwise it is wasted. This way you store it so it comes out with pressure.
quote_es: Si viene un chorro de agua hay que meterla en la alberca porque si no se desaprovecha, así almacenas para que salga con presión.
quote_en: If a stream of water comes, you have to store it in the pond, otherwise it is wasted. This way you store it so it comes out with pressure.
assumption: In case of a low water flow, water should be stored in a pond in order to irrigate with certain pressure.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”No siembro mucho si veo que va a faltar agua”. I don’t plant much if I see that water will be scarce.
quote_es: No siembro mucho si veo que va a faltar agua.
quote_en: I don’t plant much if I see that water will be scarce.
assumption: In a water shortage, the number of crops is reduced.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Puedo llenar la alberca si quiero para regar en otro momento”. I can fill the pond if I want, to water at another time.
quote_es: Puedo llenar la alberca si quiero para regar en otro momento.
quote_en: I can fill the pond if I want, to water at another time.
assumption: Irrigation hours can be used to store water in a pond for later use.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”No es lo mismo regar en la cabeza que regar en la cola”. It’s not the same to irrigate at the head of the system as it is to irrigate at the tail of it.
quote_es: No es lo mismo regar en la cabeza que regar en la cola.
quote_en: It’s not the same to irrigate at the head of the system as it is to irrigate at the tail of it.
assumption: The waiting time for water varies depending on your plot’s location — plots closer to the system’s catchment receive water sooner than those at the end.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El azud se hace con tierra y piedras, se juntaban comuneros para amontonar. Ahora se hace igual pero se llama a una excavadora”. The weir is made with earth and stones; community members would gather to pile them up. Now it’s done the same way, but an excavator is called in.
quote_es: El azud se hace con tierra y piedras, se juntaban comuneros para amontonar. Ahora se hace igual pero se llama a una excavadora.
quote_en: The weir is made with earth and stones; community members would gather to pile them up. Now it’s done the same way, but an excavator is called in.
assumption: Weirs must be made of rocks and soil so they do not pollute the water flow.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si el agua sobra porque nadie está regando, se devuelve al río”. If there is excess water because no one is irrigating, it is returned to the river.
quote_es: Si el agua sobra porque nadie está regando, se devuelve al río.
quote_en: If there is excess water because no one is irrigating, it is returned to the river.
assumption: Water remnants are brought back to the river flow.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua hay que recogerla cuando llueve”. Water must be collected when it rains.
quote_es: El agua hay que recogerla cuando llueve.
quote_en: Water must be collected when it rains.
assumption: Rainwater should be collected when it rains.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Lo importante en el riego es saber replantearlo”. The important thing in irrigation is knowing how to rethink it.
quote_es: Lo importante en el riego es saber replantearlo.
quote_en: The important thing in irrigation is knowing how to rethink it.
assumption: Irrigation is adaptive.

traditional_knowledge: ”La tierra no puede estar árida para mantener el jugo, la cubierta vegetal es importante”. The soil cannot be arid to maintain the ”juice” (moisture); plant cover is important.
quote_es: La tierra no puede estar árida para mantener el jugo, la cubierta vegetal es importante.
quote_en: The soil cannot be arid to maintain the ”juice” (moisture); plant cover is important.
assumption: Vegetal cover is important to maintain soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos arcillosos son mejores que los suelos más apretados para el cultivo de regadío”. Clay soils are better than more compacted soils for irrigated crops.
quote_es: Los suelos arcillosos son mejores que los suelos más apretados para el cultivo de regadío.
quote_en: Clay soils are better than more compacted soils for irrigated crops.
assumption: Soil porosity matters; water should percolate and be retained.

traditional_knowledge: ”La tierra expuesta al sol evapora más rápido el agua”. Soil exposed to the sun evaporates water faster.
quote_es: La tierra expuesta al sol evapora más rápido el agua.
quote_en: Soil exposed to the sun evaporates water faster.
assumption: Sun exposure accelerates water evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Aprovecho la cobertura vegetal de plantas asociadas, plantas rastreras, como la verdolaga (Portulaca oleracea) o el trébol (Trifolium repens)”. I take advantage of the plant cover from associated plants, creeping plants, such as purslane or clover.
quote_es: Aprovecho la cobertura vegetal de plantas asociadas, plantas rastreras, como la verdolaga (Portulaca oleracea) o el trébol (Trifolium repens).
quote_en: I take advantage of the plant cover from associated plants, creeping plants, such as purslane or clover.
assumption: Vegetal cover can also be achieved with groundcover plants, such as purslane and clover.

traditional_knowledge: ”La sandía se riega cada 15 o 20 días, cuando se expanden hacen de cobertura y da menos el sol”. Watermelon is watered every 15 or 20 days; when they spread out, they form cover and the sun hits less.
quote_es: La sandía se riega cada 15 o 20 días, cuando se expanden hacen de cobertura y da menos el sol.
quote_en: Watermelon is watered every 15 or 20 days; when they spread out, they form cover and the sun hits less.
assumption: Some crops can be used as groundcover to avoid water evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”No abono todos los años porque si no le meto exceso de nitrógeno a la tierra”. I don’t fertilize every year because otherwise I add excess nitrogen to the soil.
quote_es: No abono todos los años porque si no le meto exceso de nitrógeno a la tierra.
quote_en: I don’t fertilize every year because otherwise I add excess nitrogen to the soil.
assumption: Fertilizing every year can lead to an excess of nitrogen in the soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”La sectorización de mi huerta me permite tener un terreno en barbecho uno o dos años, ver el tipo de suelo que hay en cada zona y ver qué me ha funcionado mejor”. The sectorization of my orchard allows me to leave land fallow for a year or two, see the type of soil in each area, and see what has worked best for me.
quote_es: La sectorización de mi huerta me permite tener un terreno en barbecho uno o dos años, ver el tipo de suelo que hay en cada zona y ver qué me ha funcionado mejor.
quote_en: The sectorization of my orchard allows me to leave land fallow for a year or two, see the type of soil in each area, and see what has worked best for me.
assumption: A fallow land rotation system allows me to evaluate each sector of the plot.

traditional_knowledge: ”Utilizo cobertura vegetal para mantener la humedad (pasto seco), para algunos cultivos como frutales uso lana”. I use plant cover to maintain humidity (dry grass). For some crops like fruit trees, I use wool.
quote_es: Utilizo cobertura vegetal para mantener la humedad (pasto seco), para algunos cultivos como frutales uso lana.
quote_en: I use plant cover to maintain humidity (dry grass). For some crops like fruit trees, I use wool.
assumption: Vegetal and fleece covers help maintain humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”A veces uso cobertura aérea, monto un tendido por encima”. Sometimes I use aerial cover; I set up a canopy above.
quote_es: A veces uso cobertura aérea, monto un tendido por encima.
quote_en: Sometimes I use aerial cover; I set up a canopy above.
assumption: Aerial covers with tarps help maintain soil humidity and prevent transpiration.

traditional_knowledge: ”Dentro de una misma huerta puede haber distintos tipos de suelo”. Within the same orchard, there can be different types of soil.
quote_es: Dentro de una misma huerta puede haber distintos tipos de suelo.
quote_en: Within the same orchard, there can be different types of soil.
assumption: Within the same field, there can be different types of soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”En la ribera del arroyo crece mimbre (Salix viminalis), hay que controlarlo para que no se seque y tapone el cauce y también preservarlo porque mantiene las paredes del arroyo”. On the stream bank, wicker grows. It must be controlled so it doesn’t dry out and block the channel, and also preserved because it maintains the stream banks.
quote_es: En la ribera del arroyo crece mimbre (Salix viminalis), hay que controlarlo para que no se seque y tapone el cauce y también preservarlo porque mantiene las paredes del arroyo.
quote_en: On the stream bank, wicker grows. It must be controlled so it doesn’t dry out and block the channel, and also preserved because it maintains the stream banks.
assumption: Wicker (Salix viminalis) growing on stream banks helps maintain them, but it must be controlled to avoid blockages.

traditional_knowledge: ”Suelo labrar cada semana en verano para mantener la humedad en el suelo”. I till the soil every week in summer to maintain humidity in the soil.
quote_es: Suelo labrar cada semana en verano para mantener la humedad en el suelo.
quote_en: I till the soil every week in summer to maintain humidity in the soil.
assumption: Tilling the soil every week during summer helps maintain soil humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”La humedad te aguanta según la pendiente que tengas, porque el agua pasa o se detiene”. Humidity lasts depending on the slope you have, because water either passes or stops.
quote_es: La humedad te aguanta según la pendiente que tengas, porque el agua pasa o se detiene.
quote_en: Humidity lasts depending on the slope you have, because water either passes or stops.
assumption: Slope influences soil moisture, since water either drains away or is retained.

traditional_knowledge: ”De tanto regar la capa primera del suelo se compacta, eso es necesario romperlo para que filtre bien, así que hay que escardar”. From so much watering, the top layer of soil becomes compacted. It is necessary to break it up so that water filters well, so you have to weed/till.
quote_es: De tanto regar la capa primera del suelo se compacta, eso es necesario romperlo para que filtre bien, así que hay que escardar.
quote_en: From so much watering, the top layer of soil becomes compacted. It is necessary to break it up so that water filters well, so you have to weed/till.
assumption: Tilling helps water infiltrate properly.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Caballitos / niebla / barbas en Los Frontones, agua a montones”. ”Little horses / fog / beards on Los Frontones, water in tons” (saying).
quote_es: Caballitos / niebla / barbas en Los Frontones, agua a montones.
quote_en: ”Little horses / fog / beards on Los Frontones, water in tons” (saying).
assumption: Certain cloud formations can predict rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Mientras más hierba tengas, menos sol le da al suelo y pierde menos agua”. The more grass you have, the less sun hits the soil and the less water it loses.
quote_es: Mientras más hierba tengas, menos sol le da al suelo y pierde menos agua.
quote_en: The more grass you have, the less sun hits the soil and the less water it loses.
assumption: The more vegetation, the less sunlight reaches the soil, and the less water it loses.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay sequía planto cosas adaptadas a un menor requerimiento hídrico”. When there is a drought, I plant things adapted to lower water requirements.
quote_es: Cuando hay sequía planto cosas adaptadas a un menor requerimiento hídrico.
quote_en: When there is a drought, I plant things adapted to lower water requirements.
assumption: In a foreseeable drought, plant crops with lower water requirements.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para hacerme una idea de la cantidad de agua que va a haber para regar me fijo en los volúmenes de lluvias del invierno”. To get an idea of how much water will be available for irrigation, I look at the winter rainfall volumes.
quote_es: Para hacerme una idea de la cantidad de agua que va a haber para regar me fijo en los volúmenes de lluvias del invierno.
quote_en: To get an idea of how much water will be available for irrigation, I look at the winter rainfall volumes.
assumption: The amount of rainfall in winter predicts how much water is available in summer.

traditional_knowledge: ”Con más temperatura tienes que regar a veces dos veces en semana aquello que se pueda ver más afectado”. With higher temperatures, you sometimes have to water twice a week those plants that may be more affected.
quote_es: Con más temperatura tienes que regar a veces dos veces en semana aquello que se pueda ver más afectado.
quote_en: With higher temperatures, you sometimes have to water twice a week those plants that may be more affected.
assumption: Higher temperatures reduce the gap between one irrigation and another depending on the type of crop.

traditional_knowledge: ”El aire de levante seca mucho las plantas, puede que tengas que volver a regar”. The easterly wind dries out the plants a lot; you may have to irrigate again.
quote_es: El aire de levante seca mucho las plantas, puede que tengas que volver a regar.
quote_en: The easterly wind dries out the plants a lot; you may have to irrigate again.
assumption: Easterly winds (in the Arriate area) dry out plants significantly.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Cuando el grajo vuela bajo, hace un frío del carajo”. ”When the rook flies low, it’s damn cold” (saying).
quote_es: Cuando el grajo vuela bajo, hace un frío del carajo.
quote_en: ”When the rook flies low, it’s damn cold” (saying).
assumption: The low-altitude flight of certain birds is an indicator of low temperatures or an intensely cold winter.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay tres días de levante y temperaturas altas el suelo se reseca y ves que necesita agua”. If there are three days of easterly wind and high temperatures, the soil dries out and you see that it needs water.
quote_es: Si hay tres días de levante y temperaturas altas el suelo se reseca y ves que necesita agua.
quote_en: If there are three days of easterly wind and high temperatures, the soil dries out and you see that it needs water.
assumption: Wind and high temperatures can accelerate evapotranspiration.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Año de nieves, año de bienes”. Year of snow, year of goods.
quote_es: Año de nieves, año de bienes.
quote_en: Year of snow, year of goods.
assumption: Snow has some benefits for the plot (it burns weeds and maintains plowed soil humidity) and recharges water resources.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en las lluvias de la primavera para saber cuánta habrá disponible”. I look at the spring rains to know how much water will be available.
quote_es: Me fijo en las lluvias de la primavera para saber cuánta habrá disponible.
quote_en: I look at the spring rains to know how much water will be available.
assumption: The amount of rainfall in spring predicts how much water is available in summer.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Para San Andrés, ni a tu padre se las des” (30 de Noviembre). On St. Andrew’s day, don’t give them even to your father.
quote_es: Para San Andrés, ni a tu padre se las des
quote_en: (30 de Noviembre). On St. Andrew’s day, don’t give them even to your father.
assumption: Sowing by the end of November is crucial for winter crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si te pasas regando tienes que tener cuidado y hacer control de hongos.” If you overwater, you have to be careful and control fungi.
quote_es: Si te pasas regando tienes que tener cuidado y hacer control de hongos.
quote_en: If you overwater, you have to be careful and control fungi.
assumption: Water excess can cause the appearance of fungus.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay poca agua ahondo menos en los caballones, así el agua se mantiene más superficial.” If there is little water, I make the ridges shallower, so the water stays more on the surface.
quote_es: Si hay poca agua ahondo menos en los caballones, así el agua se mantiene más superficial.
quote_en: If there is little water, I make the ridges shallower, so the water stays more on the surface.
assumption: Reducing furrows’ depth during water shortage periods helps roots to reach water efficiently.

traditional_knowledge: ”Algunos cultivos se siembran en caballones y otros en llano (con amelgas) como el maíz.” Some crops are sown in ridges, and others on flat land (with amelgas), like corn.
quote_es: Algunos cultivos se siembran en caballones y otros en llano (con amelgas) como el maíz.
quote_en: Some crops are sown in ridges, and others on flat land (with amelgas), like corn.
assumption: Some crops are planted in ridges, while others are planted in plots.

traditional_knowledge: ”La menguante de agosto para sembrar cebollas y papas para el invierno.” The waning moon of August for sowing onions and potatoes for winter.
quote_es: La menguante de agosto para sembrar cebollas y papas para el invierno.
quote_en: The waning moon of August for sowing onions and potatoes for winter.
assumption: It is preferable to plant certain crops during the waning moon phase.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Todos los pujares requieren su recalo” (no por mucha humedad va mejor). All crops need their proper soil moisture (more humidity is not better).
quote_es: Todos los pujares requieren su recalo
quote_en: (no por mucha humedad va mejor). All crops need their proper soil moisture (more humidity is not better).
assumption: Excess humidity is harmful for the crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”La papa en invierno a palmo y en verano a geme.” Potatoes in winter at a span (handbreadth) and in summer at a geme (smaller measure).
quote_es: La papa en invierno a palmo y en verano a geme.
quote_en: Potatoes in winter at a span (handbreadth) and in summer at a geme (smaller measure).
assumption: The spacing between potato plants varies between winter and summer crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”Preveo que tengo de agua más o menos para planificar qué voy a plantar.” I estimate how much water I have more or less to plan what I will plant.
quote_es: Preveo que tengo de agua más o menos para planificar qué voy a plantar.
quote_en: I estimate how much water I have more or less to plan what I will plant.
assumption: Water availability influences the type of crop sown.

traditional_knowledge: ”Calculo (la necesidad de agua de un cultivo) por la tierra, si está más polvorienta o más agrietada en ese momento.” I calculate (the water need of a crop) by the soil, if it is dustier or more cracked at that moment.
quote_es: Calculo (la necesidad de agua de un cultivo) por la tierra, si está más polvorienta o más agrietada en ese momento.
quote_en: I calculate (the water need of a crop) by the soil, if it is dustier or more cracked at that moment.
assumption: Crop water requirements can be assessed by checking the soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los plantones en el centro en ’hila’ entre dos caballones, con riego por inundación tienen mejor desarrollo que por goteo, porque su sistema radicular es más pequeño.” The seedlings in the center in a row between two ridges, with flood irrigation, develop better than with drip irrigation, because their root system is smaller.
quote_es: Los plantones en el centro en ’hila’ entre dos caballones, con riego por inundación tienen mejor desarrollo que por goteo, porque su sistema radicular es más pequeño.
quote_en: The seedlings in the center in a row between two ridges, with flood irrigation, develop better than with drip irrigation, because their root system is smaller.
assumption: Irrigated crops planted in furrows have better development than drip-irrigated ones.

traditional_knowledge: ”Planto cuando planta el vecino.” I plant when the neighbor plants.
quote_es: Planto cuando planta el vecino.
quote_en: I plant when the neighbor plants.
assumption: Irrigators share a similar sowing calendar with their neighbors.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cada año se siembra antes los espárragos.” Each year asparagus is sown earlier.
quote_es: Cada año se siembra antes los espárragos.
quote_en: Each year asparagus is sown earlier.
assumption: Due to an early rise in temperature, some crops are planted earlier.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los productos hortícolas consumen más agua.” Horticultural crops consume more water.
quote_es: Los productos hortícolas consumen más agua.
quote_en: Horticultural crops consume more water.
assumption: Horticultural crops (different from trees) need more water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Normalmente es suficiente con 3 riegos durante el verano, cada 15 y 30 días como mucho.” Normally 3 waterings during the summer, every 15 to 30 days at most, is enough.
quote_es: Normalmente es suficiente con 3 riegos durante el verano, cada 15 y 30 días como mucho.
quote_en: Normally 3 waterings during the summer, every 15 to 30 days at most, is enough.
assumption: Certain crops can produce with a low irrigation frequency.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si riegas mucho el espárrago se te ahoga.” If you water asparagus too much, it drowns.
quote_es: Si riegas mucho el espárrago se te ahoga.
quote_en: If you water asparagus too much, it drowns.
assumption: Excessive watering can cause suffocation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cambias el producto si tienes menos agua (por ejemplo en vez de maíz plantas trigo o habas).” You change the crop if you have less water (for example, instead of corn you plant wheat or beans).
quote_es: Cambias el producto si tienes menos agua (por ejemplo en vez de maíz plantas trigo o habas).
quote_en: You change the crop if you have less water (for example, instead of corn you plant wheat or beans).
assumption: Water shortage can lead to changing crops in sowing season.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”En cuanto veas más oscuro al maíz, con las hojas dormidas, hay que echarle más agua.” As soon as you see corn darker, with droopy leaves, you need to add more water.
quote_es: En cuanto veas más oscuro al maíz, con las hojas dormidas, hay que echarle más agua.
quote_en: As soon as you see corn darker, with droopy leaves, you need to add more water.
assumption: Certain plant signals indicate water stress.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: Saying -”El agua calienta más que el vino.” Water heats up more than wine.
quote_es: El agua calienta más que el vino.
quote_en: Water heats up more than wine.
assumption: Traditional irrigation requires physical exercise for the irrigator. Traditional irrigation water management can lead to arguments among the users.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay falta de agua no se pueden regar barbechos.” If there is water shortage, fallow lands cannot be irrigated.
quote_es: Si hay falta de agua no se pueden regar barbechos.
quote_en: If there is water shortage, fallow lands cannot be irrigated.
assumption: During periods of water shortage, fallow lands cannot be irrigated.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay falta de agua adaptarse a las horas de riego que establece la comunidad.” If there is water shortage, adapt to the irrigation hours established by the community.
quote_es: Si hay falta de agua adaptarse a las horas de riego que establece la comunidad.
quote_en: If there is water shortage, adapt to the irrigation hours established by the community.
assumption: Water shortage forces irrigators to adapt to the irrigation hours established by the community.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando el recalo sube por el macho paro de regar.” When the moisture rises up to the middle (of the ridge), I stop irrigating.
quote_es: Cuando el recalo sube por el macho paro de regar.
quote_en: When the moisture rises up to the middle (of the ridge), I stop irrigating.
assumption: Visible moisture level on the ridge is a practical indicator to determine when to stop watering.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Riego por bancales así aprovecho mejor la humedad.” I irrigate on terraces so I make better use of the moisture.
quote_es: Riego por bancales así aprovecho mejor la humedad.
quote_en: I irrigate on terraces so I make better use of the moisture.
assumption: Irrigation on terraces helps to preserve soil moisture.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando se va a regar el espárrago se apisona un poco la amelga para que el agua corra más y no recale tanto.” When irrigating asparagus, the plot is lightly compacted so the water flows better and doesn’t seep excessively.
quote_es: Cuando se va a regar el espárrago se apisona un poco la amelga para que el agua corra más y no recale tanto.
quote_en: When irrigating asparagus, the plot is lightly compacted so the water flows better and doesn’t seep excessively.
assumption: Lightly compacting the soil helps the water flow better and prevents excessive seepage.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en otros regantes y el momento en el que riegan.” I observe other irrigators and the timing of their irrigation.
quote_es: Me fijo en otros regantes y el momento en el que riegan.
quote_en: I observe other irrigators and the timing of their irrigation.
assumption: Learning and sharing practices is possible observing other irrigators.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”(Cuando hay que aprovechar mejor el agua) hago las amelgas más estrechas.” (When we need to make better use of water) I make the plots narrower.
quote_es: (Cuando hay que aprovechar mejor el agua) hago las amelgas más estrechas.
quote_en: (When we need to make better use of water) I make the plots narrower.
assumption: Reducing the width of the plots helps take advantage of the available water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Arar a una profundidad de 60 o 70 cm hace que el agua se filtre más y se duerma ahí, no la ves andar.” Plowing to a depth of 60–70 cm makes the water infiltrate more and stay there, you don’t see it moving.
quote_es: Arar a una profundidad de 60 o 70 cm hace que el agua se filtre más y se duerma ahí, no la ves andar.
quote_en: Plowing to a depth of 60–70 cm makes the water infiltrate more and stay there, you don’t see it moving.
assumption: Plowing to a greater depth increases water infiltration and allows water to remain stored in the subsoil, with no visible surface flow.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Arar a una profundidad de 30 cm hace que el agua ande porque se filtra menos.” Plowing to a depth of 30 cm makes the water move because it infiltrates less.
quote_es: Arar a una profundidad de 30 cm hace que el agua ande porque se filtra menos.
quote_en: Plowing to a depth of 30 cm makes the water move because it infiltrates less.
assumption: Shortening plowing depth allows water to flow and infiltrate properly.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La preparación de la acequia hace que haya más o menos filtraciones.” The preparation of the irrigation channel affects there being more or less seepage.
quote_es: La preparación de la acequia hace que haya más o menos filtraciones.
quote_en: The preparation of the irrigation channel affects there being more or less seepage.
assumption: The preparation of the irrigation reduce possible water loss.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”No es lo mismo regar de noche que de día.” Irrigating at night is not the same as irrigating during the day.
quote_es: No es lo mismo regar de noche que de día.
quote_en: Irrigating at night is not the same as irrigating during the day.
assumption: Irrigating at night is not the same as irrigating during the day.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”(Si vemos que hay menos agua) espaciamos los turnos de riego, en lugar de regar cada 7 días regamos cada 15.” (If we see there is less water) we space out the irrigation turns, instead of watering every 7 days we water every 15.
quote_es: (Si vemos que hay menos agua) espaciamos los turnos de riego, en lugar de regar cada 7 días regamos cada 15.
quote_en: (If we see there is less water) we space out the irrigation turns, instead of watering every 7 days we water every 15.
assumption: In a water shortage, spacing out irrigation turns helps redistribute water among all the irrigators.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Los ajos se abren si se riegan mucho en su fase final.” Garlic bulbs split if they are overwatered in their final stage.
quote_es: Los ajos se abren si se riegan mucho en su fase final.
quote_en: Garlic bulbs split if they are overwatered in their final stage.
assumption: Garlic bulbs split if over-irrigated in their final growth stage.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando tienes una acequia con 30 litros cuando te llega al bancal te pueden llegar 25.” When you have a ditch with 30 liters, by the time it reaches your plot you might get 25.
quote_es: Cuando tienes una acequia con 30 litros cuando te llega al bancal te pueden llegar 25.
quote_en: When you have a ditch with 30 liters, by the time it reaches your plot you might get 25.
assumption: There is water loss in the transfer from the catchment to the irrigation lands.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La desventaja del riego a manta es que crías más hierba que se puede comer el beneficio de agua y nutrientes del cultivo.” The disadvantage of flood irrigation is that it grows more weeds that can consume the water and nutrient benefits of the crop.
quote_es: La desventaja del riego a manta es que crías más hierba que se puede comer el beneficio de agua y nutrientes del cultivo.
quote_en: The disadvantage of flood irrigation is that it grows more weeds that can consume the water and nutrient benefits of the crop.
assumption: Flood irrigation encourages weed growth, which competes with the crop for water and nutrients.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes regaba un canal sí y otro no para evitar demasiada humedad y la proliferación de hongos, por no meter tanta agua.” Before, I irrigated one furrow and not the next to avoid too much humidity and the proliferation of fungi, to not add so much water.
quote_es: Antes regaba un canal sí y otro no para evitar demasiada humedad y la proliferación de hongos, por no meter tanta agua.
quote_en: Before, I irrigated one furrow and not the next to avoid too much humidity and the proliferation of fungi, to not add so much water.
assumption: Alternating furrows when irrigating helps control soil humidity and the proliferation of fungi.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El riego tradicional por inundación es beneficioso para el medioambiente, para el suelo y los animales.” Traditional flood irrigation is beneficial for the environment, the soil, and the animals.
quote_es: El riego tradicional por inundación es beneficioso para el medioambiente, para el suelo y los animales.
quote_en: Traditional flood irrigation is beneficial for the environment, the soil, and the animals.
assumption: Traditional flood irrigation is beneficial for the environment, the soil, and the animals.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El riego focalizado (goteo) no mejora los suelos.” Drip irrigation does not improve the soil.
quote_es: El riego focalizado (goteo) no mejora los suelos.
quote_en: Drip irrigation does not improve the soil.
assumption: Drip irrigation has no improvement for the soil.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las costumbres integran la fauna y la flora local, vienen de antiguo además.” Customs integrate local fauna and flora, they also come from ancient times.
quote_es: Las costumbres integran la fauna y la flora local, vienen de antiguo además.
quote_en: Customs integrate local fauna and flora, they also come from ancient times.
assumption: Long-standing customs naturally incorporate and preserve local flora and fauna.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Los pujares por la mañana y las novias por la tarde.” The crops in the morning and the girlfriends in the afternoon.
quote_es: Los pujares por la mañana y las novias por la tarde.
quote_en: The crops in the morning and the girlfriends in the afternoon.
assumption: In the early hours of the morning, the plants are visibly fresh and firm due to water vapor condensation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para mantener la humedad aro para tener la tierra sueltecilla.” To maintain humidity, I plow to keep the soil loose.
quote_es: Para mantener la humedad aro para tener la tierra sueltecilla.
quote_en: To maintain humidity, I plow to keep the soil loose.
assumption: Tilling helps the soil retain humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Mantener la humedad del barbecho es importante.” Maintaining the humidity of fallow land is important.
quote_es: Mantener la humedad del barbecho es importante.
quote_en: Maintaining the humidity of fallow land is important.
assumption: It is important to keep the humidity of the fallow lands.

traditional_knowledge: ”En los olivares mantengo lo desbrozado para hacer acolchado y mantener la humedad.” In the olive groves, I keep the cleared vegetation to use as mulch and maintain humidity.
quote_es: En los olivares mantengo lo desbrozado para hacer acolchado y mantener la humedad.
quote_en: In the olive groves, I keep the cleared vegetation to use as mulch and maintain humidity.
assumption: Reaped undergrowth can be used as mulch to retain moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los acolchados regulan la transpiración del suelo y también mantienen la biodiversidad con insectos.” Mulches regulate soil transpiration and also maintain biodiversity with insects.
quote_es: Los acolchados regulan la transpiración del suelo y también mantienen la biodiversidad con insectos.
quote_en: Mulches regulate soil transpiration and also maintain biodiversity with insects.
assumption: Mulching regulates soil transpiration and also maintains biodiversity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Aprovechar las sombras de las propias plantas o de otros árboles para mantener la humedad.” Taking advantage of the shade of the plants themselves or other trees to maintain humidity.
quote_es: Aprovechar las sombras de las propias plantas o de otros árboles para mantener la humedad.
quote_en: Taking advantage of the shade of the plants themselves or other trees to maintain humidity.
assumption: Taking advantage of shade from plants or nearby trees helps retain moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando la tierra es muy arcillosa crea una capa que no percola y el agua escurre.” When the soil is very clayey, it creates a layer that does not percolate and the water runs off.
quote_es: Cuando la tierra es muy arcillosa crea una capa que no percola y el agua escurre.
quote_en: When the soil is very clayey, it creates a layer that does not percolate and the water runs off.
assumption: Very clayey soils can form a layer that prevents percolation and causes water runoff.

traditional_knowledge: ”Después de regar los barbechos hay que ararlos para que mantengan la humedad.” After irrigating fallow lands, they must be plowed to maintain moisture.
quote_es: Después de regar los barbechos hay que ararlos para que mantengan la humedad.
quote_en: After irrigating fallow lands, they must be plowed to maintain moisture.
assumption: After irrigating fallow lands, they should be plowed to maintain moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay una zona del suelo que tiene más grava por debajo vas a usar más agua. Tienes que corregir las zonas más permeables.” If an area of soil has more gravel underneath, you will use more water. You have to correct the more permeable areas.
quote_es: Si hay una zona del suelo que tiene más grava por debajo vas a usar más agua. Tienes que corregir las zonas más permeables.
quote_en: If an area of soil has more gravel underneath, you will use more water. You have to correct the more permeable areas.
assumption: If a soil area has more gravel underneath, water infiltration is higher. Permeable areas must be corrected.

traditional_knowledge: ”La misma plantación hace una cobertura natural de la radiación solar.” The plantation itself provides natural cover against solar radiation.
quote_es: La misma plantación hace una cobertura natural de la radiación solar.
quote_en: The plantation itself provides natural cover against solar radiation.
assumption: Some crops provide natural cover against solar radiation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si escasea el agua, se reduce la cantidad de terreno irrigado.” If water is scarce, the amount of irrigated land is reduced.
quote_es: Si escasea el agua, se reduce la cantidad de terreno irrigado.
quote_en: If water is scarce, the amount of irrigated land is reduced.
assumption: If water is scarce, the irrigated area is reduced.

traditional_knowledge: ”Antes se regaba una canal sí y otra no para controlar la humedad y los hongos en el espárrago.” Before, one furrow was irrigated and not the next to control humidity and fungi in asparagus.
quote_es: Antes se regaba una canal sí y otra no para controlar la humedad y los hongos en el espárrago.
quote_en: Before, one furrow was irrigated and not the next to control humidity and fungi in asparagus.
assumption: In a furrows and ridges layout, irrigation is alternated between furrows to control moisture and prevent fungal diseases in specific crops.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Cuando el ’Hacho’ trae montera, llueve quiera o no quiera.” When the ’Hacho’ peak wears a hat, it rains whether you want it or not.
quote_es: Cuando el ’Hacho’ trae montera, llueve quiera o no quiera.
quote_en: When the ’Hacho’ peak wears a hat, it rains whether you want it or not.
assumption: Some cloud accumulation on top of specific hills may indicate coming rains.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Borreguitos en la Sierra, charquitos en la tierra.” Little sheep clouds in the Sierra, little puddles on the ground.
quote_es: Borreguitos en la Sierra, charquitos en la tierra.
quote_en: Little sheep clouds in the Sierra, little puddles on the ground.
assumption: Some cloud accumulation on top of specific mountain chains may indicate coming rains.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en cuánto ha llovido durante el año para saber si va a haber más o menos agua disponible.” I look at how much it has rained during the year to know if there will be more or less water available.
quote_es: Me fijo en cuánto ha llovido durante el año para saber si va a haber más o menos agua disponible.
quote_en: I look at how much it has rained during the year to know if there will be more or less water available.
assumption: Yearly pluviometry can predict water availability.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hace mucha calor intentamos regar de noche.” When it is very hot, we try to irrigate at night.
quote_es: Cuando hace mucha calor intentamos regar de noche.
quote_en: When it is very hot, we try to irrigate at night.
assumption: During intense heat it is better to irrigate at night.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Las nieblas en el Calar, a los tres días remojá.” Fogs on the Calar peak, three days later a soaking.
quote_es: Las nieblas en el Calar, a los tres días remojá.
quote_en: Fogs on the Calar peak, three days later a soaking.
assumption: Some cloud accumulation on top of specific hills may indicate coming rains.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si riegas la papa con mucho calor se cuece.” If you irrigate potatoes in extreme heat, they cook.
quote_es: Si riegas la papa con mucho calor se cuece.
quote_en: If you irrigate potatoes in extreme heat, they cook.
assumption: Irrigating some crops during excessive heat is harmful to the plants.

traditional_knowledge: ”Que hace más fresco, tienes que regar menos.” When it is cooler, you have to water less.
quote_es: Que hace más fresco, tienes que regar menos.
quote_en: When it is cooler, you have to water less.
assumption: Irrigation frequency can be spaced out when the weather is cooler.

traditional_knowledge: ”La primavera es la que cumple con el año agrícola.” Spring is what completes the agricultural year.
quote_es: La primavera es la que cumple con el año agrícola.
quote_en: Spring is what completes the agricultural year.
assumption: Spring marks the completion of the hydrologic year.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se que les falta agua porque las hojas están tristes mirando para el suelo”. I know they lack water because the leaves look sad, pointing to the ground.
quote_es: Se que les falta agua porque las hojas están tristes mirando para el suelo.
quote_en: I know they lack water because the leaves look sad, pointing to the ground.
assumption: Plant water stress is visibly expressed through leaf wilting and drooping.

traditional_knowledge: ”Puedo mirar si les falta agua a mis plantas fijándome en la tierra, si está polvorienta necesita agua”. I can check if my plants need water by looking at the soil; if it is dusty, it needs water.
quote_es: Puedo mirar si les falta agua a mis plantas fijándome en la tierra, si está polvorienta necesita agua.
quote_en: I can check if my plants need water by looking at the soil; if it is dusty, it needs water.
assumption: Soil surface dryness is a reliable indicator of insufficient soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay cultivos que son rastreros y son buenos para la asociación de cultivos al proporcionar sombras. Como la calabaza (Cucurbita), o hierbas como la correhuela o campanilla (Convolvulus arvensis)”. There are creeping crops that are good for intercropping because they provide shade, such as pumpkin, or weeds like bindweed.
quote_es: Hay cultivos que son rastreros y son buenos para la asociación de cultivos al proporcionar sombras. Como la calabaza (Cucurbita), o hierbas como la correhuela o campanilla (Convolvulus arvensis).
quote_en: There are creeping crops that are good for intercropping because they provide shade, such as pumpkin, or weeds like bindweed.
assumption: Ground-cover crops reduce evaporation and benefit companion crops by shading the soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los eucaliptos quitan mucha agua del terreno, su corteza acidifica mucho el suelo si se usa para acolchar”. Eucalyptus trees take a lot of water from the ground, and their bark greatly acidifies the soil if used for mulching.
quote_es: Los eucaliptos quitan mucha agua del terreno, su corteza acidifica mucho el suelo si se usa para acolchar.
quote_en: Eucalyptus trees take a lot of water from the ground, and their bark greatly acidifies the soil if used for mulching.
assumption: Certain species have high water consumption and can chemically alter soil properties.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las plantas jóvenes necesitan más agua que en su fase de maduración final”. Young plants need more water than they do in their final ripening stage.
quote_es: Las plantas jóvenes necesitan más agua que en su fase de maduración final.
quote_en: Young plants need more water than they do in their final ripening stage.
assumption: Water requirements vary by growth stage and are higher during early development.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si ves babosas y caracoles es que te has pasado regando”. If you see slugs and snails, it means you have overwatered.
quote_es: Si ves babosas y caracoles es que te has pasado regando.
quote_en: If you see slugs and snails, it means you have overwatered.
assumption: Excess moisture creates favorable conditions for moisture-loving pests.

traditional_knowledge: ”Utilizo alcorques para regar los árboles”. I use tree basins to water the trees.
quote_es: Utilizo alcorques para regar los árboles.
quote_en: I use tree basins to water the trees.
assumption: Concentrating water around the root zone improves irrigation efficiency.

traditional_knowledge: ”Dejo la broza cuando siego para aportar materia orgánica al suelo”. I leave the debris when I mow to add organic matter to the soil.
quote_es: Dejo la broza cuando siego para aportar materia orgánica al suelo.
quote_en: I leave the debris when I mow to add organic matter to the soil.
assumption: Organic residues improve soil fertility.

traditional_knowledge: ”En mi finca dejo zonas sin cultivar para que crezcan hierbas salvajes, algunas son aprovechables como la caléndula (Calendula), la malva (Malva sylvestris)”. On my farm, I leave uncultivated areas for wild herbs to grow; some are useful, such as calendula and mallow.
quote_es: En mi finca dejo zonas sin cultivar para que crezcan hierbas salvajes, algunas son aprovechables como la caléndula (Calendula), la malva (Malva sylvestris).
quote_en: On my farm, I leave uncultivated areas for wild herbs to grow; some are useful, such as calendula and mallow.
assumption: Wild herbs can provide ecological and practical benefits.

traditional_knowledge: ”Aprovecho la sombra que dan los árboles en mi parcela para controlar la exposición al sol de ciertos cultivos”. I take advantage of the shade from the trees on my plot to control sun exposure for certain crops.
quote_es: Aprovecho la sombra que dan los árboles en mi parcela para controlar la exposición al sol de ciertos cultivos.
quote_en: I take advantage of the shade from the trees on my plot to control sun exposure for certain crops.
assumption: Microclimate management, taking advantage of the shade from trees, improves crop performance by reducing sun exposure.

traditional_knowledge: ”Algunos cultivos son buenos para abrir la tierra (esponjar) como por ejemplo las legumbres”. Some crops are good for opening up (loosening) the soil, such as legumes.
quote_es: Algunos cultivos son buenos para abrir la tierra (esponjar) como por ejemplo las legumbres.
quote_en: Some crops are good for opening up (loosening) the soil, such as legumes.
assumption: Certain root systems help improve soil structure and aeration.

traditional_knowledge: ”A algunos cultivos no les gusta el acolchado (como la col y la cebolla)”. Some crops do not like mulching, such as cabbage and onion.
quote_es: A algunos cultivos no les gusta el acolchado (como la col y la cebolla).
quote_en: Some crops do not like mulching, such as cabbage and onion.
assumption: Mulching effects vary by crop species and may negatively affect some.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los árboles agradecen más el riego a manta, porque el riego por goteo les mengua las raíces”. Trees prefer flood irrigation because drip irrigation reduces their root system.
quote_es: Los árboles agradecen más el riego a manta, porque el riego por goteo les mengua las raíces.
quote_en: Trees prefer flood irrigation because drip irrigation reduces their root system.
assumption: Irrigation method influences root system development.

traditional_knowledge: ”El viento seca mucho los cultivos”. The wind dries out crops a lot.
quote_es: El viento seca mucho los cultivos.
quote_en: The wind dries out crops a lot.
assumption: Wind increases evapotranspiration.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hacer asociación de cultivos evita plagas (albahaca entre tomateras, o rosales entre vides)”. Intercropping prevents pests (basil among tomato plants, or rose bushes among grapevines).
quote_es: Hacer asociación de cultivos evita plagas (albahaca entre tomateras, o rosales entre vides).
quote_en: Intercropping prevents pests (basil among tomato plants, or rose bushes among grapevines).
assumption: Intercropping reduces pest incidence through ecological interactions.

traditional_knowledge: ”Planto cultivos con las mismas necesidades juntos”. I plant crops with the same needs together.
quote_es: Planto cultivos con las mismas necesidades juntos.
quote_en: I plant crops with the same needs together.
assumption: Grouping crops with similar water demands improves irrigation efficiency.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para plantar me guío por los calendarios de siembra, el calendario lunar y cuando empiezan a plantar mis vecinos”. For planting, I am guided by sowing calendars, the lunar calendar, and when my neighbors start planting.
quote_es: Para plantar me guío por los calendarios de siembra, el calendario lunar y cuando empiezan a plantar mis vecinos.
quote_en: For planting, I am guided by sowing calendars, the lunar calendar, and when my neighbors start planting.
assumption: Sowing timing based on tradition, environmental cycles (lunar calendar), and social knowledge improves crop development.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si me sale maleza la dejo para proteger el suelo de la exposición al sol y la erosión”. If weeds come up, I leave them to protect the soil from sun exposure and erosion.
quote_es: Si me sale maleza la dejo para proteger el suelo de la exposición al sol y la erosión.
quote_en: If weeds come up, I leave them to protect the soil from sun exposure and erosion.
assumption: Vegetative cover reduces erosion and moisture loss.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para plantar nos fijamos en el tiempo, la temperatura y la humedad”. For planting, we look at the weather, temperature, and humidity.
quote_es: Para plantar nos fijamos en el tiempo, la temperatura y la humedad.
quote_en: For planting, we look at the weather, temperature, and humidity.
assumption: Climatic conditions directly influence germination.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las patatas se tienen que regar cada 10 días cuando están creciendo”. Potatoes should be watered every ten days when they are growing.
quote_es: Las patatas se tienen que regar cada 10 días cuando están creciendo.
quote_en: Potatoes should be watered every ten days when they are growing.
assumption: Regular, spaced irrigation at fixed intervals meets the water needs of growing potatoes.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las hortalizas las tienes que regar todas las semanas durante periodos de calor y sequedad”. Vegetables need to be watered every week during periods of heat and drought.
quote_es: Las hortalizas las tienes que regar todas las semanas durante periodos de calor y sequedad.
quote_en: Vegetables need to be watered every week during periods of heat and drought.
assumption: Vegetables need to be watered every week during periods of heat and drought.

traditional_knowledge: ”El trigo aguanta más entre riego y riego durante períodos más calurosos que las hortalizas”. Wheat withstands longer intervals between waterings during hotter periods than vegetables do.
quote_es: El trigo aguanta más entre riego y riego durante períodos más calurosos que las hortalizas.
quote_en: Wheat withstands longer intervals between waterings during hotter periods than vegetables do.
assumption: Wheat tolerates longer irrigation intervals than vegetable crops during hot periods.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El tamaño de la parcela condiciona el volumen de agua que se usa para regar”. The size of the plot determines the volume of water used for irrigation.
quote_es: El tamaño de la parcela condiciona el volumen de agua que se usa para regar.
quote_en: The size of the plot determines the volume of water used for irrigation.
assumption: Water requirements scale with cultivated area.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si ha llovido no se riegan olivos ni trigo en régimen de riego eventual”. If it has rained, olive trees and wheat are not irrigated under occasional irrigation systems.
quote_es: Si ha llovido no se riegan olivos ni trigo en régimen de riego eventual.
quote_en: If it has rained, olive trees and wheat are not irrigated under occasional irrigation systems.
assumption: Rainfall can substitute for irrigation depending on crop and system.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Lo ideal para regar es hacer los relés y luego regar donde estén los cultivos”. The ideal way to irrigate is to make the distribution channels (reles) and then water where the crops are.
quote_es: Lo ideal para regar es hacer los relés y luego regar donde estén los cultivos.
quote_en: The ideal way to irrigate is to make the distribution channels (reles) and then water where the crops are.
assumption: Proper infrastructure preparation ensures efficient water distribution.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para decidir cuánta agua le echo me fijo en el estado de la planta”. To decide how much water to apply, I look at the condition of the plant.
quote_es: Para decidir cuánta agua le echo me fijo en el estado de la planta.
quote_en: To decide how much water to apply, I look at the condition of the plant.
assumption: Visible signs of the plant are reliable irrigation indicators.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Me guío por el año pluviométrico para saber más o menos cuánta agua habrá disponible en verano”. I use the rainfall year as a guide to know roughly how much water will be available in summer.
quote_es: Me guío por el año pluviométrico para saber más o menos cuánta agua habrá disponible en verano.
quote_en: I use the rainfall year as a guide to know roughly how much water will be available in summer.
assumption: Annual precipitation patterns determine seasonal water availability.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”(Para optimizar el agua) Para los árboles hago unos alcorques alrededor, que están conectados con la canalización. Para los sembrados (trigo y cebada) le hago un culebreo para evitar la erosión y que vaya empapando bien”. (To optimize water) For trees, I make tree basins around them, connected to the channel. For sown crops (wheat and barley), I make a serpentine channel to avoid erosion and ensure good soaking.
quote_es: (Para optimizar el agua) Para los árboles hago unos alcorques alrededor, que están conectados con la canalización. Para los sembrados (trigo y cebada) le hago un culebreo para evitar la erosión y que vaya empapando bien.
quote_en: (To optimize water) For trees, I make tree basins around them, connected to the channel. For sown crops (wheat and barley), I make a serpentine channel to avoid erosion and ensure good soaking.
assumption: Field design influences infiltration and erosion control.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Agua que no es de beber, déjala correr”. Water that is not for drinking, let it flow.
quote_es: Agua que no es de beber, déjala correr.
quote_en: Water that is not for drinking, let it flow.
assumption: Irrigation water should be used or allowed to circulate rather than wasted.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si veo que no voy a tener mucha agua para regar reduzco mis cultivos o evito plantar cultivos con altas exigencias hídricas”. If I see that I will not have much water for irrigation, I reduce my crops or avoid planting crops with high water demands.
quote_es: Si veo que no voy a tener mucha agua para regar reduzco mis cultivos o evito plantar cultivos con altas exigencias hídricas.
quote_en: If I see that I will not have much water for irrigation, I reduce my crops or avoid planting crops with high water demands.
assumption: Crop planning must adapt to expected water availability. In a water shortage, reduce crops or avoid planting high water demanding ones.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El riego tiene que ser a manta si no se cuartea la tierra”. Irrigation must be flood irrigation, otherwise the soil cracks.
quote_es: El riego tiene que ser a manta si no se cuartea la tierra.
quote_en: Irrigation must be flood irrigation, otherwise the soil cracks.
assumption: Flood irrigation maintains soil structure by preventing cracks from dryness.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El azud se hace de piedras y tierra, se juntaban antes todos los comuneros a amontonar”. The weir is made of stones and earth; in the past, all the commoners would gather to pile them up.
quote_es: El azud se hace de piedras y tierra, se juntaban antes todos los comuneros a amontonar.
quote_en: The weir is made of stones and earth; in the past, all the commoners would gather to pile them up.
assumption: Irrigation infrastructure construction and maintenance require collective community labor.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Los pozos personales esquilman mucho el agua del subsuelo”. Private wells overexploit the groundwater.
quote_es: Los pozos personales esquilman mucho el agua del subsuelo.
quote_en: Private wells overexploit the groundwater.
assumption: Individual extraction can overexploit aquifers.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Recuperar los careos de la montaña nos permite regar en otros sistemas más bajos”. Restoring the mountain recharge channels allows us to irrigate in lower systems.
quote_es: Recuperar los careos de la montaña nos permite regar en otros sistemas más bajos.
quote_en: Restoring the mountain recharge channels allows us to irrigate in lower systems.
assumption: Managed infiltration upstream sustains downstream water availability.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Los restos de riego son devueltos al río”. Leftover irrigation water is returned to the river.
quote_es: Los restos de riego son devueltos al río.
quote_en: Leftover irrigation water is returned to the river.
assumption: Irrigation systems are part of a broader hydrological cycle and return irrigation water remainders.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua se queda retenida en los bancales”. Water is retained in the terraces.
quote_es: El agua se queda retenida en los bancales.
quote_en: Water is retained in the terraces.
assumption: Terracing enhances water retention.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Acumulamos el agua en la balsa para aprovechar la presión para regar”. We store water in the pond to take advantage of pressure for irrigation.
quote_es: Acumulamos el agua en la balsa para aprovechar la presión para regar.
quote_en: We store water in the pond to take advantage of pressure for irrigation.
assumption: Elevation and storage improve gravity-fed irrigation efficiency.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La preparación de la acequia antes de los riegos de verano ayuda a que haya menos filtraciones”. Preparing the ditch before summer irrigation helps reduce seepage.
quote_es: La preparación de la acequia antes de los riegos de verano ayuda a que haya menos filtraciones.
quote_en: Preparing the ditch before summer irrigation helps reduce seepage.
assumption: Maintenance improves water-use efficiency.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si riegas a medio día tienes que tener cuidado de no cocer las plantas”. If you water at midday, you have to be careful not to cook the plants.
quote_es: Si riegas a medio día tienes que tener cuidado de no cocer las plantas.
quote_en: If you water at midday, you have to be careful not to cook the plants.
assumption: High temperatures combined with irrigation can damage crops.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
