traditional_knowledge: ”En verano si hay menos agua se espacian las tandas de riego”. In summer, if there is less water, irrigation shifts are spaced further apart.
quote_es: En verano si hay menos agua se espacian las tandas de riego.
quote_en: In summer, if there is less water, irrigation shifts are spaced further apart.
assumption: Scarcity requires temporal rationing.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si viene mucha agua aviso antes al vecino de abajo para que esté preparado para cuando yo corte”. If a lot of water is coming, I let the neighbor downstream know so he is ready for when I cut it off.
quote_es: Si viene mucha agua aviso antes al vecino de abajo para que esté preparado para cuando yo corte.
quote_en: If a lot of water is coming, I let the neighbor downstream know so he is ready for when I cut it off.
assumption: Irrigation requires coordination and collective management.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La creación de cuchillos ayuda a frenar la velocidad del agua y hacer que avance lento penetrando bien en el suelo”. Creating small earth ridges (cuchillos) helps slow down the water speed, making it advance slowly and penetrate the soil well.
quote_es: La creación de cuchillos ayuda a frenar la velocidad del agua y hacer que avance lento penetrando bien en el suelo.
quote_en: Creating small earth ridges (cuchillos) helps slow down the water speed, making it advance slowly and penetrate the soil well.
assumption: Creating small earth ridges slows water flow so it increases infiltration and reduces erosion.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Riego por tasquivas, antes de que el agua haya llegado a la cola la corto”. I irrigate using small distribution channels (tasquivas); before the water has reached the tail, I cut it off.
quote_es: Riego por tasquivas, antes de que el agua haya llegado a la cola la corto.
quote_en: I irrigate using small distribution channels (tasquivas); before the water has reached the tail, I cut it off.
assumption: Controlled distribution improves uniformity and efficiency.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si has dejado barbecho, lo puedes regar una o dos veces al año para preparar la tierra”. If you have left land fallow, you can irrigate it once or twice a year to prepare the soil.
quote_es: Si has dejado barbecho, lo puedes regar una o dos veces al año para preparar la tierra.
quote_en: If you have left land fallow, you can irrigate it once or twice a year to prepare the soil.
assumption: Occasional irrigation in fallow lands improves soil condition.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si riego por calles y sé que voy a tener poca agua, reduzco el tamaño de las tasquivas (por donde pasa el agua)”. If I water by furrows (calles) and I know I will have little water, I reduce the size of the small distribution channels (tasquivas).
quote_es: Si riego por calles y sé que voy a tener poca agua, reduzco el tamaño de las tasquivas (por donde pasa el agua).
quote_en: If I water by furrows (calles) and I know I will have little water, I reduce the size of the small distribution channels (tasquivas).
assumption: Smaller channels optimize limited water supply.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si la tierra está labrada chupa más agua, si no y está más compacta, corre más y no filtra igual”. If the soil is tilled, it absorbs more water; if it is more compacted, the water runs off and does not infiltrate as well.
quote_es: Si la tierra está labrada chupa más agua, si no y está más compacta, corre más y no filtra igual.
quote_en: If the soil is tilled, it absorbs more water; if it is more compacted, the water runs off and does not infiltrate as well.
assumption: Soil structure determines infiltration capacity: loose soil allows high infiltration while compact soil allows water to flow.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay una cubierta vegetal el agua va más despacio y se infiltra más lentamente”. If there is plant cover, the water moves more slowly and infiltrates better.
quote_es: Si hay una cubierta vegetal el agua va más despacio y se infiltra más lentamente.
quote_en: If there is plant cover, the water moves more slowly and infiltrates better.
assumption: Ground cover enhances infiltration and reduces runoff.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se riega de distinta forma según el tipo de cultivo, si son hortalizas por caballones y si es maíz, trigo o alfalfa se riega por inundación en una extensión”. Irrigation is done differently depending on the crop type: vegetables by ridges and furrows, and maize, wheat, or alfalfa by flood irrigation over an extended area.
quote_es: Se riega de distinta forma según el tipo de cultivo, si son hortalizas por caballones y si es maíz, trigo o alfalfa se riega por inundación en una extensión.
quote_en: Irrigation is done differently depending on the crop type: vegetables by ridges and furrows, and maize, wheat, or alfalfa by flood irrigation over an extended area.
assumption: Irrigation technique should match crop type.

traditional_knowledge: ”La humedad del suelo influye, hace que tengas que adelantar o atrasar el riego”. Soil moisture influences irrigation; it may cause you to advance or delay watering.
quote_es: La humedad del suelo influye, hace que tengas que adelantar o atrasar el riego.
quote_en: Soil moisture influences irrigation; it may cause you to advance or delay watering.
assumption: Irrigation timing depends on existing soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Mantengo una cubierta vegetal que en verano hace que no se seque tanto la tierra”. I maintain plant cover, which in summer prevents the soil from drying out too much.
quote_es: Mantengo una cubierta vegetal que en verano hace que no se seque tanto la tierra.
quote_en: I maintain plant cover, which in summer prevents the soil from drying out too much.
assumption: Vegetal cover reduces evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay que tener en cuenta la inclinación y la pendiente en la parcela para regar bien”. You have to take into account the inclination and slope of the plot to irrigate well.
quote_es: Hay que tener en cuenta la inclinación y la pendiente en la parcela para regar bien.
quote_en: You have to take into account the inclination and slope of the plot to irrigate well.
assumption: The topography of the land affects water flow and distribution.

traditional_knowledge: ”Utilizo un acolchado para mantener la humedad en el suelo”. I use mulching to maintain soil moisture.
quote_es: Utilizo un acolchado para mantener la humedad en el suelo.
quote_en: I use mulching to maintain soil moisture.
assumption: Mulching reduces soil moisture evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos arcillosos son buenos para el regadío”. Clay soils are good for irrigated farming.
quote_es: Los suelos arcillosos son buenos para el regadío.
quote_en: Clay soils are good for irrigated farming.
assumption: Clay soils’ water-holding capacity benefits irrigated farming.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos arenosos no son tan buenos para el regadío, se filtra antes y se seca la capa superficial”. Sandy soils are not as good for irrigated farming; water filters through quickly and the surface layer dries out.
quote_es: Los suelos arenosos no son tan buenos para el regadío, se filtra antes y se seca la capa superficial.
quote_en: Sandy soils are not as good for irrigated farming; water filters through quickly and the surface layer dries out.
assumption: Sandy soils’ low water retention reduces irrigation efficiency.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en el suelo para saber si falta agua en el cultivo”. I look at the soil to know if the crop lacks water.
quote_es: Me fijo en el suelo para saber si falta agua en el cultivo.
quote_en: I look at the soil to know if the crop lacks water.
assumption: Soil appearance indicates moisture status.

traditional_knowledge: ”En lugares con pendiente se construyen los bancales, ayudan a retener la humedad y el suelo, previniendo la erosión”. On sloping land, terraces are built; they help retain moisture and soil, preventing erosion.
quote_es: En lugares con pendiente se construyen los bancales, ayudan a retener la humedad y el suelo, previniendo la erosión.
quote_en: On sloping land, terraces are built; they help retain moisture and soil, preventing erosion.
assumption: Terracing enables cultivation on slopes, retains moisture, and prevents soil erosion.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos esponjosos con turba son suelos sanos”. Spongy soils with peat are healthy soils.
quote_es: Los suelos esponjosos con turba son suelos sanos.
quote_en: Spongy soils with peat are healthy soils.
assumption: Organic matter content indicates soil health.

traditional_knowledge: ”El suelo desertificado es prácticamente impermeable y amenaza la erosión”. Desertified soil is practically impermeable and threatens erosion.
quote_es: El suelo desertificado es prácticamente impermeable y amenaza la erosión.
quote_en: Desertified soil is practically impermeable and threatens erosion.
assumption: Soil degradation reduces infiltration and increases erosion risk.

traditional_knowledge: ”En las acequias de careo, la infiltración en la ladera evita la erosión y retorna el agua infiltrándola en el acuífero”. In mountain recharge channels (acequias de careo), infiltration on the hillside prevents erosion and returns water by recharging the aquifer.
quote_es: En las acequias de careo, la infiltración en la ladera evita la erosión y retorna el agua infiltrándola en el acuífero.
quote_en: In mountain recharge channels (acequias de careo), infiltration on the hillside prevents erosion and returns water by recharging the aquifer.
assumption: In mountain recharge channels, managed infiltration supports groundwater recharge.

traditional_knowledge: ”El agua de lluvia pone dura la tierra, la apelmaza”. Rainwater makes the soil hard and compacts it.
quote_es: El agua de lluvia pone dura la tierra, la apelmaza.
quote_en: Rainwater makes the soil hard and compacts it.
assumption: The impact of rainfall can reduce soil porosity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Que no baile el agua, debe de avanzar lentamente”. The water should not dance (move turbulently); it should advance slowly.
quote_es: Que no baile el agua, debe de avanzar lentamente.
quote_en: The water should not dance (move turbulently); it should advance slowly.
assumption: Gentle flow maximizes infiltration and minimizes erosion.

traditional_knowledge: ”A los tres días de haber regado, muevo la tierra superficial para tapar las grietas y mantener una corteza que evite la evaporación del agua”. Three days after watering, I move the surface soil to seal the cracks and maintain a crust that prevents water evaporation.
quote_es: A los tres días de haber regado, muevo la tierra superficial para tapar las grietas y mantener una corteza que evite la evaporación del agua.
quote_en: Three days after watering, I move the surface soil to seal the cracks and maintain a crust that prevents water evaporation.
assumption: Surface soil management after irrigation reduces water evaporation by sealing cracks.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para estimar un poco cómo va a ir el verano me fijo en las últimas nieves que caen en Sierra Nevada, si nieva por marzo o abril hay agua hasta agosto con un caudal considerable”. To get an idea of how summer will go, I look at the last snowfalls in the Sierra Nevada; if it snows in March or April, there will be water until August with a considerable flow.
quote_es: Para estimar un poco cómo va a ir el verano me fijo en las últimas nieves que caen en Sierra Nevada, si nieva por marzo o abril hay agua hasta agosto con un caudal considerable.
quote_en: To get an idea of how summer will go, I look at the last snowfalls in the Sierra Nevada; if it snows in March or April, there will be water until August with a considerable flow.
assumption: Snowpack determines summer river flow.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en la sequedad y humedad del ambiente para saber cuánta agua echar”. I look at the dryness and humidity of the environment to know how much water to apply.
quote_es: Me fijo en la sequedad y humedad del ambiente para saber cuánta agua echar.
quote_en: I look at the dryness and humidity of the environment to know how much water to apply.
assumption: Atmospheric conditions influence evapotranspiration and therefore water consumption.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Cielo aborregao, a los dos días mojao”. Cloudy sky like sheep’s wool, two days later it’s wet.
quote_es: Cielo aborregao, a los dos días mojao.
quote_en: Cloudy sky like sheep’s wool, two days later it’s wet.
assumption: Specific cloud patterns predict rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”El agua de abril se mete toda en un barril”. April water all fits into a single barrel.
quote_es: El agua de abril se mete toda en un barril.
quote_en: April water all fits into a single barrel.
assumption: Spring water, still scarce, is valuable and should be stored.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si la tormenta viene del Manar, ya puedes sacar la burra a pastar”. If the storm comes from Manar, you can take the donkey out to graze.
quote_es: Si la tormenta viene del Manar, ya puedes sacar la burra a pastar.
quote_en: If the storm comes from Manar, you can take the donkey out to graze.
assumption: Visible cloud accumulation in certain zones of the area predicts potential heavy rains.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Aguas por San Juan, quitan vino y no dan pan”. Rain around St. John’s Day (June 24) takes away wine and does not give bread.
quote_es: Aguas por San Juan, quitan vino y no dan pan.
quote_en: Rain around St. John’s Day (June 24) takes away wine and does not give bread.
assumption: Excess water during the final stage of ripening causes significant damage.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si ha llovido en primavera vamos a tener más agua”. If it has rained in spring, we will have more water.
quote_es: Si ha llovido en primavera vamos a tener más agua.
quote_en: If it has rained in spring, we will have more water.
assumption: Spring rainfall replenishes water resources.

traditional_knowledge: ”Miras a Sierra Nevada para ver cuánta nieve tiene (deshielo alimenta caudal del río)”. You look at the Sierra Nevada to see how much snow it has (the snowmelt feeds the river flow).
quote_es: Miras a Sierra Nevada para ver cuánta nieve tiene (deshielo alimenta caudal del río).
quote_en: You look at the Sierra Nevada to see how much snow it has (the snowmelt feeds the river flow).
assumption: Snowpack sustains river discharge.

traditional_knowledge: ”Agua de cielo no quita riego”. Water from the sky does not replace irrigation.
quote_es: Agua de cielo no quita riego.
quote_en: Water from the sky does not replace irrigation.
assumption: Rainfall alone may be insufficient for crop needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si ves los vencejos (Apus apus) sabes que se acerca la calor”. If you see swifts, you know that the heat is approaching.
quote_es: Si ves los vencejos (Apus apus) sabes que se acerca la calor.
quote_en: If you see swifts, you know that the heat is approaching.
assumption: Animal behavior signals seasonal change.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Marzo ventoso y abril lluvioso, sacan a mayo florido y hermoso”. Windy March and rainy April bring a flowery and beautiful May.
quote_es: Marzo ventoso y abril lluvioso, sacan a mayo florido y hermoso.
quote_en: Windy March and rainy April bring a flowery and beautiful May.
assumption: Seasonal weather sequences influence crop development.

traditional_knowledge: ”El olor a humedad indica lluvia”. The smell of humidity indicates rain.
quote_es: El olor a humedad indica lluvia.
quote_en: The smell of humidity indicates rain.
assumption: The smell of humidity indicates rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en la tierra para saber cuanta agua echarle, si está muy seca o si tiene jugo”. I look at the soil to know how much water to apply, if it is very dry or if it has moisture.
quote_es: Me fijo en la tierra para saber cuanta agua echarle, si está muy seca o si tiene jugo.
quote_en: I look at the soil to know how much water to apply, if it is very dry or if it has moisture.
assumption: Visible soil dryness is an indicator to irrigate.

traditional_knowledge: ”Depende del cultivo (decido cuanta agua echarle)”. It depends on the crop (I decide how much water to apply).
quote_es: Depende del cultivo (decido cuanta agua echarle).
quote_en: It depends on the crop (I decide how much water to apply).
assumption: The water requirements of each crop influence the amount of water used.

traditional_knowledge: ”(Los cultivos necesitan agua) cuando veo que tienen las hojas arrugadas o están lacias y marchitas, además la tierra también te lo dice, cuando está muy seca. Las olivas se arrugan”. (The crops need water) when I see that they have wrinkled leaves or are limp and wilted, and the soil also tells you, when it is very dry. The olives wrinkle.
quote_es: (Los cultivos necesitan agua) cuando veo que tienen las hojas arrugadas o están lacias y marchitas, además la tierra también te lo dice, cuando está muy seca. Las olivas se arrugan.
quote_en: (The crops need water) when I see that they have wrinkled leaves or are limp and wilted, and the soil also tells you, when it is very dry. The olives wrinkle.
assumption: The lack of water is visible in indicators such as soil dryness, the firmness or color of the plant or its fruits.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si has cargado la era mucho de estiércoles no dejes pasar el turno de agua, porque si no se queman las raíces”. If you have put a lot of manure on the threshing floor, do not miss your water turn, otherwise the roots will burn.
quote_es: Si has cargado la era mucho de estiércoles no dejes pasar el turno de agua, porque si no se queman las raíces.
quote_en: If you have put a lot of manure on the threshing floor, do not miss your water turn, otherwise the roots will burn.
assumption: Prolonged lack of water after manuring damages the roots.

traditional_knowledge: ”Todo lo que se siembra en menguante resulta mejor”. Everything that is sown during the waning moon turns out better.
quote_es: Todo lo que se siembra en menguante resulta mejor.
quote_en: Everything that is sown during the waning moon turns out better.
assumption: Crops sown during the waning moon have better development.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los árboles en los extremos (de la terraza) y en el centro siembras trigo, panizo o habichuelas”. The trees on the edges (of the terrace) and in the center you sow wheat, millet or beans.
quote_es: Los árboles en los extremos (de la terraza) y en el centro siembras trigo, panizo o habichuelas.
quote_en: The trees on the edges (of the terrace) and in the center you sow wheat, millet or beans.
assumption: The distribution of crops in the plot makes it possible to take advantage of space and carry out efficient irrigation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay que sembrar a la misma vez el panizo y las habichuelas”. Millet and beans must be sown at the same time.
quote_es: Hay que sembrar a la misma vez el panizo y las habichuelas.
quote_en: Millet and beans must be sown at the same time.
assumption: Some crops, such as millet or beans, must be sown together.

traditional_knowledge: ”Riego con distinta frecuencia las vetuallas (hortalizas) que quieren más agua, igual que los frutales. Pero los olivos los riego tres o cuatro veces al año”. I water the vetuallas (vegetables) with different frequency, as they want more water, as do fruit trees. But I water the olive trees three or four times a year.
quote_es: Riego con distinta frecuencia las vetuallas (hortalizas) que quieren más agua, igual que los frutales. Pero los olivos los riego tres o cuatro veces al año.
quote_en: I water the vetuallas (vegetables) with different frequency, as they want more water, as do fruit trees. But I water the olive trees three or four times a year.
assumption: Different crops have different water demands.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando riegas árboles por goteo le haces daño a las raíces que están muy cerca de la tierra”. When you drip-irrigate trees, you damage the roots that are very close to the soil.
quote_es: Cuando riegas árboles por goteo le haces daño a las raíces que están muy cerca de la tierra.
quote_en: When you drip-irrigate trees, you damage the roots that are very close to the soil.
assumption: Drip irrigation can reduce the root development of trees.

traditional_knowledge: ”Al final una se guía por el calendario popular (para plantar)”. In the end, one is guided by the popular calendar (for planting).
quote_es: Al final una se guía por el calendario popular (para plantar).
quote_en: In the end, one is guided by the popular calendar (for planting).
assumption: The popular calendar (sayings, lunar phases, saints, special dates, etc.) is a sufficient and reliable practical guide to decide when to plant.

traditional_knowledge: ”La mata te lo canta (si le falta agua), también las hierbas del campo se ven más apagadas”. The plant tells you (if it needs water), and the field herbs also look duller.
quote_es: La mata te lo canta (si le falta agua), también las hierbas del campo se ven más apagadas.
quote_en: The plant tells you (if it needs water), and the field herbs also look duller.
assumption: Water needs can be visually confirmed in the crops and also in the growing herbs.

traditional_knowledge: ”También puedes regar en la retorná, riegas la mitad de horas de tu turno en una tanda y cuando ya haya regado la cola, las horas que sobran las puedes regar en la retorná”. You can also irrigate in the retorná, you irrigate half the hours of your turn in one go and when the tail-end has already irrigated, the remaining hours you can irrigate in the retorná.
quote_es: También puedes regar en la retorná, riegas la mitad de horas de tu turno en una tanda y cuando ya haya regado la cola, las horas que sobran las puedes regar en la retorná.
quote_en: You can also irrigate in the retorná, you irrigate half the hours of your turn in one go and when the tail-end has already irrigated, the remaining hours you can irrigate in the retorná.
assumption: With scarce water, the head-end farmer gives up part of his turn so that the tail-end can irrigate and then takes advantage of the water that ”returns”, thus ensuring that the water reaches the tail-end.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay que regar la punta de las raíces de los árboles para que avancen”. You have to water the tips of the tree roots so that they advance.
quote_es: Hay que regar la punta de las raíces de los árboles para que avancen.
quote_en: You have to water the tips of the tree roots so that they advance.
assumption: The growth and development of a tree’s root system can be encouraged by applying water specifically to the area where the tips of the growing roots are located.

traditional_knowledge: ”Es malo sonregar (volver a echar agua después de regar)”. It is bad to sonregar (to add water again after irrigating).
quote_es: Es malo sonregar (volver a echar agua después de regar).
quote_en: It is bad to sonregar (to add water again after irrigating).
assumption: Excess water in the soil can lead to crop suffocation.

traditional_knowledge: ”La Almajara es la germinación de la simiente del tomate y el pimiento, se sembraban en la tierra directamente y se abonaba. Esto se cubría con el Albardín (Lygeum spartum) para evitar las heladas. Una vez en primavera se retiraba el Albardín y en San Juan se transplantaba la mata de la almajara al bancal”. The Almajara is the germination of tomato and pepper seeds, they were sown directly in the ground and fertilized. This was covered with Albardín (Lygeum spartum) to prevent frost. Once in spring the Albardín was removed and on St. John’s Day the almajara seedlings were transplanted to the plot.
quote_es: La Almajara es la germinación de la simiente del tomate y el pimiento, se sembraban en la tierra directamente y se abonaba. Esto se cubría con el Albardín (Lygeum spartum) para evitar las heladas. Una vez en primavera se retiraba el Albardín y en San Juan se transplantaba la mata de la almajara al bancal.
quote_en: The Almajara is the germination of tomato and pepper seeds, they were sown directly in the ground and fertilized. This was covered with Albardín (Lygeum spartum) to prevent frost. Once in spring the Albardín was removed and on St. John’s Day the almajara seedlings were transplanted to the plot.
assumption: Sowing tomatoes and peppers directly in the ground protected by mulch prevents frost until the moment of transplanting.

traditional_knowledge: ”El producto que más duraba en el bancal era el trigo, la cebada y la alfalfa. La alfalfa se sembraba en eras y la ibas segando e iba creciendo. Era fundamental para el ganado”. The product that lasted the longest in the plot was wheat, barley and alfalfa. Alfalfa was sown on threshing floors and you would cut it and it would keep growing. It was essential for livestock.
quote_es: El producto que más duraba en el bancal era el trigo, la cebada y la alfalfa. La alfalfa se sembraba en eras y la ibas segando e iba creciendo. Era fundamental para el ganado.
quote_en: The product that lasted the longest in the plot was wheat, barley and alfalfa. Alfalfa was sown on threshing floors and you would cut it and it would keep growing. It was essential for livestock.
assumption: Wheat, barley and alfalfa are the crops that remain the longest in the plot, with alfalfa standing out for its ability to regrow after multiple cuttings.

traditional_knowledge: ”El aprovechamiento de las malas hierbas era un bien necesario para el ganado y las bestias, porque en los bancales se soltaban para que pastasen”. The use of weeds was a necessary good for livestock and beasts, because they were let loose in the plots to graze.
quote_es: El aprovechamiento de las malas hierbas era un bien necesario para el ganado y las bestias, porque en los bancales se soltaban para que pastasen.
quote_en: The use of weeds was a necessary good for livestock and beasts, because they were let loose in the plots to graze.
assumption: Weeds can be used to feed livestock.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Año de alzavarones (Agave americana), trigo en la era y aceite en los bidones”. Saying - ”Year of alzavarones (Agave americana), wheat on the threshing floor and oil in the containers.”
quote_es: Año de alzavarones (Agave americana), trigo en la era y aceite en los bidones.
quote_en: Saying - ”Year of alzavarones (Agave americana), wheat on the threshing floor and oil in the containers.”
assumption: When many inflorescences appear in the summer, the next agricultural year is going to be good.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”A las habas mucho riego y pocas cavas”. Saying - ”Lots of irrigation and little digging for beans.”
quote_es: A las habas mucho riego y pocas cavas.
quote_en: Saying - ”Lots of irrigation and little digging for beans.”
assumption: Some crops such as beans need a lot of water and do not tolerate being tilled well.

traditional_knowledge: ”Planto en los márgenes de mi bancal romero, rosales y lavanda para que se le peguen las plagas ahí”. I plant rosemary, roses and lavender on the edges of my plot so that the pests stick to them.
quote_es: Planto en los márgenes de mi bancal romero, rosales y lavanda para que se le peguen las plagas ahí.
quote_en: I plant rosemary, roses and lavender on the edges of my plot so that the pests stick to them.
assumption: Planting aromatic plants on the edges of the plot can act as a trap crop or pest repellent, protecting the main crops.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay un año de sequía muy grande se modifican las tandas” motes. If there is a year of very great drought, the irrigation shifts motes are modified.
quote_es: Si hay un año de sequía muy grande se modifican las tandas
quote_en: motes. If there is a year of very great drought, the irrigation shifts motes are modified.
assumption: Irrigation shifts can be modified in case of water shortage.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: (Para saber cuanta agua habrá disponible en la mina de la rambla) ”Según la lluvia, y el año pluviométrico”. (To know how much water will be available in the rambla mine) ”Depending on the rain, and the pluviometric year.”
quote_es: Según la lluvia, y el año pluviométrico.
quote_en: (To know how much water will be available in the rambla mine) ”Depending on the rain, and the pluviometric year.”
assumption: Annual precipitation can help predict irrigation water availability.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las fuentes que tenemos no tienen un caudal muy variable”. The springs we have do not have a very variable flow.
quote_es: Las fuentes que tenemos no tienen un caudal muy variable.
quote_en: The springs we have do not have a very variable flow.
assumption: Some springs provide a relatively stable flow throughout the year.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Modificamos la tanda de 13-14 días, a 1820 días (...) Ahorramos agua aprovechando y repartiendo mejor la que tenemos”. We modify the shift from 13-14 days to 18-20 days (...) We save water by taking better advantage of and distributing what we have.
quote_es: Modificamos la tanda de 13-14 días, a 1820 días (...) Ahorramos agua aprovechando y repartiendo mejor la que tenemos.
quote_en: We modify the shift from 13-14 days to 18-20 days (...) We save water by taking better advantage of and distributing what we have.
assumption: Lengthening the shift allows better use and distribution of the available water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las atochás permiten crear semidiques, como balsas o lagunas pequeñas que evitan la erosión del suelo. Si se dirigen pueden recargar fuentes más abajo, son un aporte de agua al terreno en zonas de lluvias escasas”. The atochás allow the creation of semi-dams, like small pools or lagoons that prevent soil erosion. If directed, they can recharge springs further down; they are a contribution of water to the land in areas of scarce rainfall.
quote_es: Las atochás permiten crear semidiques, como balsas o lagunas pequeñas que evitan la erosión del suelo. Si se dirigen pueden recargar fuentes más abajo, son un aporte de agua al terreno en zonas de lluvias escasas.
quote_en: The atochás allow the creation of semi-dams, like small pools or lagoons that prevent soil erosion. If directed, they can recharge springs further down; they are a contribution of water to the land in areas of scarce rainfall.
assumption: Structures such as atochás, located in key areas of hollows and ravines, stop soil erosion and retain water in the terrain, potentially recharging springs at lower levels.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las canalizaciones que se hacen a lo largo del cauce de la rambla permiten que en las venidas estacionales, se transporte el agua por encima de las minas para recargarlas”. The channels built along the rambla riverbed allow the water to be transported above the water mines during seasonal flows to recharge them.
quote_es: Las canalizaciones que se hacen a lo largo del cauce de la rambla permiten que en las venidas estacionales, se transporte el agua por encima de las minas para recargarlas.
quote_en: The channels built along the rambla riverbed allow the water to be transported above the water mines during seasonal flows to recharge them.
assumption: Water mines can be recharged by taking advantage of the seasonal courses of the rambla.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Con el careo del agua se puede conducir hacia las fuentes y alimentarlas”. With the careo of water, it can be directed towards the springs to feed them.
quote_es: Con el careo del agua se puede conducir hacia las fuentes y alimentarlas.
quote_en: With the careo of water, it can be directed towards the springs to feed them.
assumption: Water can be channeled and infiltrated in specific sites to recharge springs for irrigation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El salto de agua de la balsa se intenta llevar a una zona concreta y que se infiltre para alimentar otra fuente”. The waterfall from the pond is directed to a specific area so that it infiltrates and feeds another spring.
quote_es: El salto de agua de la balsa se intenta llevar a una zona concreta y que se infiltre para alimentar otra fuente.
quote_en: The waterfall from the pond is directed to a specific area so that it infiltrates and feeds another spring.
assumption: The surplus water from a pond can be channeled to feed another spring further down.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”También es un conocimiento antiguo, lo que he visto toda mi vida desde pequeño con mis abuelos”. It is also an ancient knowledge, what I have seen all my life since I was a child with my grandparents.
quote_es: También es un conocimiento antiguo, lo que he visto toda mi vida desde pequeño con mis abuelos.
quote_en: It is also an ancient knowledge, what I have seen all my life since I was a child with my grandparents.
assumption: The antiquity and intergenerational transmission of a practice guarantee its effectiveness and validity.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Tienes unas horas determinadas de agua, en un momento malo (de falta de agua) la comunidad hace un nuevo reparto”. You have a set number of hours of water, in a bad time (of water shortage) the community makes a new distribution.
quote_es: Tienes unas horas determinadas de agua, en un momento malo (de falta de agua) la comunidad hace un nuevo reparto.
quote_en: You have a set number of hours of water, in a bad time (of water shortage) the community makes a new distribution.
assumption: In a time of drought or water shortage, the community readjusts and distributes the irrigation hours.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”También se pueden dar casos de venta y préstamo de horas”. There may also be cases of selling and lending hours.
quote_es: También se pueden dar casos de venta y préstamo de horas.
quote_en: There may also be cases of selling and lending hours.
assumption: Sometimes irrigation hours can be sold or transferred by agreement.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Las cimbras necesitan sus arreglos y limpiar las galerías, antes había que mandar a dos personas a limpiar las lumbreras para poder entrar y salir era riesgoso”. The water mines need their repairs and to clean the galleries; before, you had to send two people to clean the shafts to be able to enter and exit, it was risky.
quote_es: Las cimbras necesitan sus arreglos y limpiar las galerías, antes había que mandar a dos personas a limpiar las lumbreras para poder entrar y salir era riesgoso.
quote_en: The water mines need their repairs and to clean the galleries; before, you had to send two people to clean the shafts to be able to enter and exit, it was risky.
assumption: Water mines and galleries need to be cleaned to avoid blockages.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Los árboles se plantaban en los márgenes de la terraza, así aprovechan el agua de riego que les metes a los cultivos”. The trees were planted on the edges of the terrace, so they take advantage of the irrigation water you apply to the crops.
quote_es: Los árboles se plantaban en los márgenes de la terraza, así aprovechan el agua de riego que les metes a los cultivos.
quote_en: The trees were planted on the edges of the terrace, so they take advantage of the irrigation water you apply to the crops.
assumption: The trees planted on the edges of the terraces take advantage of the retained water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Ahora muchas fuentes en la rambla y más abajo se han secado, no llueve igual que antes y ahora hay pozos en algunas zonas”. Now many springs in the rambla and further down have dried up, it doesn’t rain like before and now there are wells in some areas.
quote_es: Ahora muchas fuentes en la rambla y más abajo se han secado, no llueve igual que antes y ahora hay pozos en algunas zonas.
quote_en: Now many springs in the rambla and further down have dried up, it doesn’t rain like before and now there are wells in some areas.
assumption: The irrigation water from the cimbras needs rainfall recharge to have flow. Water catchments at higher elevations can deplete the water supply from springs at lower elevations.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Hago las eras más estrechas, así economizo más el agua”. I make the threshing floors narrower, so I save more water.
quote_es: Hago las eras más estrechas, así economizo más el agua.
quote_en: I make the threshing floors narrower, so I save more water.
assumption: Reducing the width of the threshing floors allows better use of water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Hay que arreglar tramos de galerías y las acequias para evitar filtraciones”. You have to repair sections of galleries and irrigation ditches to avoid leaks.
quote_es: Hay que arreglar tramos de galerías y las acequias para evitar filtraciones.
quote_en: You have to repair sections of galleries and irrigation ditches to avoid leaks.
assumption: Repairs and maintenance of the infrastructure prevent water leaks.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes iba con mi madre a lavar la ropa a la fuente”. I used to go with my mother to wash clothes at the spring.
quote_es: Antes iba con mi madre a lavar la ropa a la fuente.
quote_en: I used to go with my mother to wash clothes at the spring.
assumption: Springs dedicated to irrigation can also be used as a washing place.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La distribución de los cultivos importa, hay que poner juntos los que sabes que toman la misma agua, así riegas mejor”. The distribution of crops matters, you have to put together those that you know take the same water, so you irrigate better.
quote_es: La distribución de los cultivos importa, hay que poner juntos los que sabes que toman la misma agua, así riegas mejor.
quote_en: The distribution of crops matters, you have to put together those that you know take the same water, so you irrigate better.
assumption: Grouping crops by water needs favors the irrigation task.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Aquí hay algunas fuentes en las que se riega a hilo, en otras tienen balsa”. Here there are some springs where you irrigate directly, in others they have a pond.
quote_es: Aquí hay algunas fuentes en las que se riega a hilo, en otras tienen balsa.
quote_en: Here there are some springs where you irrigate directly, in others they have a pond.
assumption: From the springs, you can irrigate directly with the flow they provide or store it in ponds.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Se colocaban abrevaderos para los animales”. Water troughs were placed for the animals.
quote_es: Se colocaban abrevaderos para los animales.
quote_en: Water troughs were placed for the animals.
assumption: Irrigation water is also used for animal consumption.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La acequia pasa por debajo de la rambla, hay un común (sifón) a cada lado que conecta y transporta el agua de lado al otro”. The irrigation ditch passes under the rambla, there is a común (siphon) on each side that connects and transports water from one side to the other.
quote_es: La acequia pasa por debajo de la rambla, hay un común (sifón) a cada lado que conecta y transporta el agua de lado al otro.
quote_en: The irrigation ditch passes under the rambla, there is a común (siphon) on each side that connects and transports water from one side to the other.
assumption: Irrigation water can be conveyed under the rambla to distribute the water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para que aumenten las fuentes tiene que correr el agua por la rambla”. For the springs to increase, water must flow through the rambla.
quote_es: Para que aumenten las fuentes tiene que correr el agua por la rambla.
quote_en: For the springs to increase, water must flow through the rambla.
assumption: The visible water flowing through the rambla is an indicator of spring recharge.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes había muchas más boqueras, encauzaban las aguas que venían de la rambla para aprovechar cuando salía”. Before there were many more boqueras, they channeled the water that came from the rambla to take advantage of it when it came.
quote_es: Antes había muchas más boqueras, encauzaban las aguas que venían de la rambla para aprovechar cuando salía.
quote_en: Before there were many more boqueras, they channeled the water that came from the rambla to take advantage of it when it came.
assumption: The sporadic waters of the rambla are used for irrigation by channeling them.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si veo que me va a faltar puedo comprar más horas de riego en la subasta”. If I see that I am going to be short, I can buy more irrigation hours at the auction.
quote_es: Si veo que me va a faltar puedo comprar más horas de riego en la subasta.
quote_en: If I see that I am going to be short, I can buy more irrigation hours at the auction.
assumption: Irrigation hours are transferable under mutual agreement.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cada uno tiene las horas que le corresponda según la extensión de tierra que posea”. Each one has the hours that correspond to them according to the extent of land they own.
quote_es: Cada uno tiene las horas que le corresponda según la extensión de tierra que posea.
quote_en: Each one has the hours that correspond to them according to the extent of land they own.
assumption: Irrigation hours are distributed according to the extent of land owned.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si escasea el agua siembro menos cultivos”. If water is scarce, I sow fewer crops.
quote_es: Si escasea el agua siembro menos cultivos.
quote_en: If water is scarce, I sow fewer crops.
assumption: If water is scarce, the same surface area cannot be maintained.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”También (cuando escasea) encumbro el agua en la acequia pero esto lleva más tiempo”. Also (when it is scarce) I raise the water level in the ditch but this takes more time.
quote_es: También (cuando escasea) encumbro el agua en la acequia pero esto lleva más tiempo.
quote_en: Also (when it is scarce) I raise the water level in the ditch but this takes more time.
assumption: Increasing the water level in the ditch by accumulating more flow and partially closing the outlet helps to be able to irrigate with adequate pressure.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Se debería de mantener un margen entre las cabeceras de las galerías y donde se haga un pozo, sino se puede secar las fuentes”. A margin should be maintained between the heads of the galleries and where a well is dug, otherwise the springs can dry up.
quote_es: Se debería de mantener un margen entre las cabeceras de las galerías y donde se haga un pozo, sino se puede secar las fuentes.
quote_en: A margin should be maintained between the heads of the galleries and where a well is dug, otherwise the springs can dry up.
assumption: Water extraction at the head of the galleries dries up the springs.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Aprendí a fuerza de que se me fuera el agua”. I learned by force of having the water run away from me.
quote_es: Aprendí a fuerza de que se me fuera el agua.
quote_en: I learned by force of having the water run away from me.
assumption: Flood irrigation requires practice to carry out efficiently.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”A diferencia de otras fuentes de la rambla, aquí se riega para tras para y no se hacen subastas de horas”. Unlike other springs in the rambla, here irrigation is done one plot after the other and there are no hour auctions.
quote_es: A diferencia de otras fuentes de la rambla, aquí se riega para tras para y no se hacen subastas de horas.
quote_en: Unlike other springs in the rambla, here irrigation is done one plot after the other and there are no hour auctions.
assumption: Irrigation should be done sequentially from one plot to the next, without market-based hour redistribution.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si tengo menos agua no riego en todas las tandas los árboles frutales”. If I have less water, I don’t water the fruit trees in all the shifts.
quote_es: Si tengo menos agua no riego en todas las tandas los árboles frutales.
quote_en: If I have less water, I don’t water the fruit trees in all the shifts.
assumption: In a water shortage, some crops have priority over others.

traditional_knowledge: ”La presencia de hierbas cuando haces un regadío tan continuo y homogéneo no quita agua, en el secano sí”. The presence of weeds when you do such continuous and homogeneous irrigation does not take away water, but in dryland it does.
quote_es: La presencia de hierbas cuando haces un regadío tan continuo y homogéneo no quita agua, en el secano sí.
quote_en: The presence of weeds when you do such continuous and homogeneous irrigation does not take away water, but in dryland it does.
assumption: Weeds growing in lands irrigated by ditches do not compete for water in the same way as those that grow in dryland areas.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las hierbas favorecen al suelo para que no pierda agua”. Weeds help the soil so that it does not lose water.
quote_es: Las hierbas favorecen al suelo para que no pierda agua.
quote_en: Weeds help the soil so that it does not lose water.
assumption: Weeds help maintain soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando labras y dejas una capa de tierra por encima favorece que no haya transpiraciones y se evapore humedad del suelo”. When you till and leave a layer of soil on top, it helps prevent transpiration and soil moisture from evaporating.
quote_es: Cuando labras y dejas una capa de tierra por encima favorece que no haya transpiraciones y se evapore humedad del suelo.
quote_en: When you till and leave a layer of soil on top, it helps prevent transpiration and soil moisture from evaporating.
assumption: A layer of slightly compacted soil helps form a crust that reduces water evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para pasar el verano se acortan las tandas”. To get through the summer, the irrigation shifts are shortened.
quote_es: Para pasar el verano se acortan las tandas.
quote_en: To get through the summer, the irrigation shifts are shortened.
assumption: Irrigation shifts are adaptable to water availability.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se embalsa el agua porque sale poca cantidad, para que coja presión y aumente el caudal para regar”. The water is dammed because little comes out, so that it gains pressure and increases the flow for irrigation.
quote_es: Se embalsa el agua porque sale poca cantidad, para que coja presión y aumente el caudal para regar.
quote_en: The water is dammed because little comes out, so that it gains pressure and increases the flow for irrigation.
assumption: The correct pressure and flow for irrigation can be achieved by damming the water from the spring.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay atochás en los barrancos, que recogen escorrentías, pedrizas y ribazos y a su margen se sembraba trigo, cebada o algunos árboles”. There are atochás in the ravines, which collect runoff, stones and banks, and on their edge wheat, barley or some trees were sown.
quote_es: Hay atochás en los barrancos, que recogen escorrentías, pedrizas y ribazos y a su margen se sembraba trigo, cebada o algunos árboles.
quote_en: There are atochás in the ravines, which collect runoff, stones and banks, and on their edge wheat, barley or some trees were sown.
assumption: The retention of runoff water by the atochás allows sowing crops such as wheat, barley or certain trees near them.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se labra después de regar para esponjar la tierra”. It is tilled after watering to loosen the soil.
quote_es: Se labra después de regar para esponjar la tierra.
quote_en: It is tilled after watering to loosen the soil.
assumption: The remaining moisture from recent irrigation is the optimal condition for tilling, it helps to loosen the soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”Antes labraba los olivos y la tierra del bancal, pero ahora dejo la hierba y la voy segando, es mejor para el suelo, no hace escorrentías el agua”. I used to till the olive trees and the soil of the plot, but now I leave the grass and mow it, it is better for the soil, the water does not run off.
quote_es: Antes labraba los olivos y la tierra del bancal, pero ahora dejo la hierba y la voy segando, es mejor para el suelo, no hace escorrentías el agua.
quote_en: I used to till the olive trees and the soil of the plot, but now I leave the grass and mow it, it is better for the soil, the water does not run off.
assumption: Maintaining a living plant cover that is mowed periodically benefits the health and structure of the soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”Hay que cavar para mantener el jugo en la tierra”. You have to cavar (till) to keep the juice in the soil.
quote_es: Hay que cavar para mantener el jugo en la tierra.
quote_en: You have to cavar (till) to keep the juice in the soil.
assumption: Tilling helps retain moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para mantener la humedad va muy bien el estiércol con paja para hacer acolchado, tampoco hay que apretar la tierra”. To maintain humidity, manure with straw works very well for mulching, nor should you compact the soil.
quote_es: Para mantener la humedad va muy bien el estiércol con paja para hacer acolchado, tampoco hay que apretar la tierra.
quote_en: To maintain humidity, manure with straw works very well for mulching, nor should you compact the soil.
assumption: A layer of manure with straw conserves moisture by reducing evaporation, and not compacting the soil preserves porosity for water to infiltrate.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos arenosos son muy malos para el regadío porque pierden agua”. Sandy soils are very bad for irrigation because they lose water.
quote_es: Los suelos arenosos son muy malos para el regadío porque pierden agua.
quote_en: Sandy soils are very bad for irrigation because they lose water.
assumption: Sandy soils infiltrate water quickly.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando venía la rambla y entraba por la boquera e iba llenando los bancales depositaba el lodo de la rambla”. When the rambla flow came and entered through the boquera and filled the plots, it deposited the silt from the rambla.
quote_es: Cuando venía la rambla y entraba por la boquera e iba llenando los bancales depositaba el lodo de la rambla.
quote_en: When the rambla flow came and entered through the boquera and filled the plots, it deposited the silt from the rambla.
assumption: The boquera system helped deposit silty-clay materials in the crop fields.

traditional_knowledge: ”La ramblá (avenidas de agua) de 1973 bajó el nivel de la rambla unos centímetros, por lo que las boqueras se quedaron más altas”. The ramblá (flash flood) of 1973 lowered the level of the rambla by a few centimeters, so the boqueras were left higher.
quote_es: La ramblá (avenidas de agua) de 1973 bajó el nivel de la rambla unos centímetros, por lo que las boqueras se quedaron más altas.
quote_en: The ramblá (flash flood) of 1973 lowered the level of the rambla by a few centimeters, so the boqueras were left higher.
assumption: The phenomena of intense rains and large, rapid flows erode the rambla bed, forcing the modification of the boquera catchment systems.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Bancal regado, a los ocho días labrado”. Saying - ”Irrigated plot, tilled eight days later.”
quote_es: Bancal regado, a los ocho días labrado.
quote_en: Saying - ”Irrigated plot, tilled eight days later.”
assumption: Tilling eight days after irrigation helps retain soil humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si el suelo tiene suficiente humedad no hace falta regarlo porque puedes hacer barro”. If the soil has enough moisture, you don’t need to irrigate it because you can make mud.
quote_es: Si el suelo tiene suficiente humedad no hace falta regarlo porque puedes hacer barro.
quote_en: If the soil has enough moisture, you don’t need to irrigate it because you can make mud.
assumption: The ability to form mud from the soil is a direct indicator of sufficient moisture for crop growth, making irrigation unnecessary.

traditional_knowledge: ”La broza después de labrar la dejo en el suelo para que se envuelva y quede más esponjoso”. After tilling, I leave the plant debris on the soil so that it gets incorporated and becomes looser.
quote_es: La broza después de labrar la dejo en el suelo para que se envuelva y quede más esponjoso.
quote_en: After tilling, I leave the plant debris on the soil so that it gets incorporated and becomes looser.
assumption: Leaving plant debris on the soil surface after tilling contributes to the formation of organic matter and improves soil structure and porosity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Aunque veas nubes, si el viento viene de Vélez Rubio llueve, si el viento es de poniente no llueve”. Even if you see clouds, if the wind comes from Vélez Rubio it rains, if the wind is from the west it does not rain.
quote_es: Aunque veas nubes, si el viento viene de Vélez Rubio llueve, si el viento es de poniente no llueve.
quote_en: Even if you see clouds, if the wind comes from Vélez Rubio it rains, if the wind is from the west it does not rain.
assumption: Wind direction is an indicator of rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: ”(Para saber si va a llover) me fijo en el color del cielo”. (To know if it is going to rain) I look at the colour of the sky.
quote_es: (Para saber si va a llover) me fijo en el color del cielo.
quote_en: (To know if it is going to rain) I look at the colour of the sky.
assumption: The colour of the sky is an indicator of rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Si el Peñón de la Cruz tiene montera, llueve quiera Dios o no quiera”. Saying - ”If the Peñón de la Cruz has a cap, it rains whether God wants it or not.”
quote_es: Si el Peñón de la Cruz tiene montera, llueve quiera Dios o no quiera.
quote_en: Saying - ”If the Peñón de la Cruz has a cap, it rains whether God wants it or not.”
assumption: The approach of certain cloud formations is an indicator of rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando sacas a pacer a las ovejas y las ves comer desesperadas casi al día siguiente o nieve o llueve”. When you take the sheep out to graze and you see them eating desperately, almost the next day it either snows or rains.
quote_es: Cuando sacas a pacer a las ovejas y las ves comer desesperadas casi al día siguiente o nieve o llueve.
quote_en: When you take the sheep out to graze and you see them eating desperately, almost the next day it either snows or rains.
assumption: Livestock behaviour is an indicator of possible rain or snow.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las nieblas de agua son penachos o jirones de niebla muy bajas que se forman por la montaña y el valle, si las ves puede que al poco llueva”. The water fogs are plumes or shreds of very low fog that form on the mountain and in the valley, if you see them it might rain soon.
quote_es: Las nieblas de agua son penachos o jirones de niebla muy bajas que se forman por la montaña y el valle, si las ves puede que al poco llueva.
quote_en: The water fogs are plumes or shreds of very low fog that form on the mountain and in the valley, if you see them it might rain soon.
assumption: Certain low cloud formations in the mountains are an indicator of possible rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Me fijo en cuánto ha llovido ese año para saber si voy a tener más o menos agua en verano”. I look at how much it has rained that year to know if I will have more or less water in summer.
quote_es: Me fijo en cuánto ha llovido ese año para saber si voy a tener más o menos agua en verano.
quote_en: I look at how much it has rained that year to know if I will have more or less water in summer.
assumption: The pluviometric year is an indicator of water availability during the summer.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Hasta el cuarenta de mayo no te quites el sayo”. Saying - ”Until the fortieth of May, do not take off your coat.”
quote_es: Hasta el cuarenta de mayo no te quites el sayo.
quote_en: Saying - ”Until the fortieth of May, do not take off your coat.”
assumption: The temperature can drop just before the summer season.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Año de nieves, año de bienes”. Saying - ”Year of snow, year of goods.”
quote_es: Año de nieves, año de bienes.
quote_en: Saying - ”Year of snow, year of goods.”
assumption: The accumulation of snow is a sign of water availability for irrigation.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Si en enero oyes tronar, ensancha la era y agranda el pajar”. Saying - ”If you hear thunder in January, widen the threshing floor and enlarge the haystack.”
quote_es: Si en enero oyes tronar, ensancha la era y agranda el pajar.
quote_en: Saying - ”If you hear thunder in January, widen the threshing floor and enlarge the haystack.”
assumption: Rains with thunder in January are beneficial for increasing production.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Agua del cielo no quita riego”. Saying - ”Water from the sky does not replace irrigation.”
quote_es: Agua del cielo no quita riego.
quote_en: Saying - ”Water from the sky does not replace irrigation.”
assumption: Rainwater is sometimes insufficient for crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”En verano salía un nublo por el noroeste y se le llamaba ’El viejo Gor’, cuando se formaba se decía que era peligroso, porque aseguraba una lluvia que podía ser torrencial”. In summer a cloud would come out from the northwest and they called it ’El viejo Gor’, when it formed it was said to be dangerous, because it ensured a rain that could be torrential.
quote_es: En verano salía un nublo por el noroeste y se le llamaba ’El viejo Gor’, cuando se formaba se decía que era peligroso, porque aseguraba una lluvia que podía ser torrencial.
quote_en: In summer a cloud would come out from the northwest and they called it ’El viejo Gor’, when it formed it was said to be dangerous, because it ensured a rain that could be torrential.
assumption: Certain cloud formations coming from specific areas can indicate torrential rains.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando ves a las cabras corriendo a resguardarse a las vaguadas es que va a llover”. When you see goats running to take shelter in the hollows, it is going to rain.
quote_es: Cuando ves a las cabras corriendo a resguardarse a las vaguadas es que va a llover.
quote_en: When you see goats running to take shelter in the hollows, it is going to rain.
assumption: Livestock behaviour can be an indicator that rain is approaching.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para plantar tienes que fijarte en la fecha en la que estás y en la temperatura que está haciendo”. To plant you have to look at the date you are on and the temperature it is.
quote_es: Para plantar tienes que fijarte en la fecha en la que estás y en la temperatura que está haciendo.
quote_en: To plant you have to look at the date you are on and the temperature it is.
assumption: Seasonal weather and temperature influence the planting calendar.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando ves a los pájaros en bandadas volando bajo se decía que era un signo de que iba a llover”. When you see birds flying low in flocks, it was said to be a sign that it was going to rain.
quote_es: Cuando ves a los pájaros en bandadas volando bajo se decía que era un signo de que iba a llover.
quote_en: When you see birds flying low in flocks, it was said to be a sign that it was going to rain.
assumption: Low flight of birds is an indicator of possible rain.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Niebla en la sierra, agua en la tierra”. Saying - ”Fog in the mountains, water in the land.”
quote_es: Niebla en la sierra, agua en la tierra.
quote_en: Saying - ”Fog in the mountains, water in the land.”
assumption: The presence of fog on the peaks and high slopes is a reliable indicator that it may rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay tormenta en el Cerro Pelado es cuando más agua baja por la rambla”. When there is a storm on Cerro Pelado, that is when the most water flows down the rambla.
quote_es: Cuando hay tormenta en el Cerro Pelado es cuando más agua baja por la rambla.
quote_en: When there is a storm on Cerro Pelado, that is when the most water flows down the rambla.
assumption: Rain accumulations in certain areas feed the flow of the rambla.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Agua en San Juan, quita vino, quita aceite y no da pan”. Saying - ”Rain on St. John’s Day, takes away wine, takes away oil, and does not give bread.”
quote_es: Agua en San Juan, quita vino, quita aceite y no da pan.
quote_en: Saying - ”Rain on St. John’s Day, takes away wine, takes away oil, and does not give bread.”
assumption: For vines, olives and wheat, rain around June is harmful.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Por todos los santos las nieves en lo alto”. Saying - ”By All Saints’ Day, the snows are up high.”
quote_es: Por todos los santos las nieves en lo alto.
quote_en: Saying - ”By All Saints’ Day, the snows are up high.”
assumption: It is expected to find snow on the mountain peaks around All Saints’ Day (November 1st), it indicates the arrival of winter season.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Marzo airoso y abril lluvioso sacan a mayo florido y hermoso”. Saying - ”Windy March and rainy April bring a flowery and beautiful May.”
quote_es: Marzo airoso y abril lluvioso sacan a mayo florido y hermoso.
quote_en: Saying - ”Windy March and rainy April bring a flowery and beautiful May.”
assumption: Favorable weather conditions in March and April (wind and rain) promote abundant spring growth and flowering in May.

traditional_knowledge: Saying - ”Fosca en la sierra, agua en la tierra”. Saying - ”Darkness in the mountains, water in the land.”
quote_es: Fosca en la sierra, agua en la tierra.
quote_en: Saying - ”Darkness in the mountains, water in the land.”
assumption: The darkening of the mountains due to cloud cover or fog is a reliable indicator of impending rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si ves franjas rojas en el cielo por la tarde es que viene viento”. If you see red stripes in the sky in the afternoon, wind is coming.
quote_es: Si ves franjas rojas en el cielo por la tarde es que viene viento.
quote_en: If you see red stripes in the sky in the afternoon, wind is coming.
assumption: Reddish streaks in the evening sky are an indicator of incoming wind..

traditional_knowledge: ”Las malas hierbas roban el agua a los cultivos.” Weeds steal water from crops.
quote_es: Las malas hierbas roban el agua a los cultivos.
quote_en: Weeds steal water from crops.
assumption: Weeds compete with crops for water availability.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las hojas arrugadas de limonero son un indicativo de falta de agua del cultivo.” Wrinkled lemon tree leaves are an indicator of lack of water in the crop.
quote_es: Las hojas arrugadas de limonero son un indicativo de falta de agua del cultivo.
quote_en: Wrinkled lemon tree leaves are an indicator of lack of water in the crop.
assumption: Wrinkled tree leaves indicate a lack of water.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las zonas donde nacen las bojas (matas) son las mejores para plantar.” The areas where bushes grow are the best for planting.
quote_es: Las zonas donde nacen las bojas (matas) son las mejores para plantar.
quote_en: The areas where bushes grow are the best for planting.
assumption: Bushes indicate favorable planting zones.

traditional_knowledge: ”Durante la floración si le falta agua se estresa el limonero.” If the lemon tree lacks water during flowering, it becomes stressed.
quote_es: Durante la floración si le falta agua se estresa el limonero.
quote_en: If the lemon tree lacks water during flowering, it becomes stressed.
assumption: Lack of water during the blooming period can affect the performance of the lemon tree.

traditional_knowledge: ”El limón verna requiere menos recursos hídricos que el liso.” The Verna lemon requires less water resources than the smooth lemon.
quote_es: El limón verna requiere menos recursos hídricos que el liso.
quote_en: The Verna lemon requires less water resources than the smooth lemon.
assumption: Some varieties of fruit trees require less water than others.

traditional_knowledge: ”Una buena polinización es importante para la producción y para el cultivo.” Good pollination is important for production and for the crop.
quote_es: Una buena polinización es importante para la producción y para el cultivo.
quote_en: Good pollination is important for production and for the crop.
assumption: Pollination benefits production and crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”El género se blandea si le falta agua.” The fruit softens if it lacks water.
quote_es: El género se blandea si le falta agua.
quote_en: The fruit softens if it lacks water.
assumption: Soft fruit indicates a lack of water.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si tienes malas hierbas y están mustias falta agua.” If you have weeds on the plot and they are wilted, there is a lack of water.
quote_es: Si tienes malas hierbas y están mustias falta agua.
quote_en: If you have weeds on the plot and they are wilted, there is a lack of water.
assumption: Lack of humidity can be checked on weeds.

traditional_knowledge: ”Con la fruta no hay más remedio que regar.” With fruit trees, there is no choice but to irrigate.
quote_es: Con la fruta no hay más remedio que regar.
quote_en: With fruit trees, there is no choice but to irrigate.
assumption: Fruit trees demand a high volume of water.

traditional_knowledge: ”La hierba hay que quitarla porque si no, echa simientes.” You must remove weeds; otherwise, they will produce seeds.
quote_es: La hierba hay que quitarla porque si no, echa simientes.
quote_en: You must remove weeds; otherwise, they will produce seeds.
assumption: Weeds must be trimmed at the proper time to keep them under control.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua tarda más en andar cuando el suelo está más árido.” Water flows more slowly when the soil is more arid.
quote_es: El agua tarda más en andar cuando el suelo está más árido.
quote_en: Water flows more slowly when the soil is more arid.
assumption: Arid soils delay water infiltration.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Los caballones más estrechos hacen que haya menos superficie para regar, por lo que se utiliza menos agua.” Narrower ridges reduce the irrigation area, so less water is used.
quote_es: Los caballones más estrechos hacen que haya menos superficie para regar, por lo que se utiliza menos agua.
quote_en: Narrower ridges reduce the irrigation area, so less water is used.
assumption: Narrower ridges reduce water consumption.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si riegas a manta y a los 15 días aras, el árbol aguanta mejor hasta el próximo riego.” If you flood irrigate and plow after 15 days, the tree withstands better until the next watering.
quote_es: Si riegas a manta y a los 15 días aras, el árbol aguanta mejor hasta el próximo riego.
quote_en: If you flood irrigate and plow after 15 days, the tree withstands better until the next watering.
assumption: Plowing 15 days after irrigation helps maintain soil humidity.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuanta más cantidad de agua entre, más cantidad de árboles y rapidez puedes regar.” The more water that enters, the more trees you can irrigate and the faster you can do it.
quote_es: Cuanta más cantidad de agua entre, más cantidad de árboles y rapidez puedes regar.
quote_en: The more water that enters, the more trees you can irrigate and the faster you can do it.
assumption: High water supply in a plot increases the extension you can irrigate in a shorter time.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay hierba el agua va más lenta.” If there are weeds, the water flows more slowly.
quote_es: Si hay hierba el agua va más lenta.
quote_en: If there are weeds, the water flows more slowly.
assumption: Weed presence can delay water flow and increase watering time.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La hierba es una competencia por el agua.” Weeds are competition for water.
quote_es: La hierba es una competencia por el agua.
quote_en: Weeds are competition for water.
assumption: Weeds compete with crops for water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El riego por inundación recoge semillas y las distribuye.” Flood irrigation picks up seeds and distributes them.
quote_es: El riego por inundación recoge semillas y las distribuye.
quote_en: Flood irrigation picks up seeds and distributes them.
assumption: Flood irrigation helps disperse seeds across the plot.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La acequia mantiene la biodiversidad.” The irrigation ditch maintains biodiversity.
quote_es: La acequia mantiene la biodiversidad.
quote_en: The irrigation ditch maintains biodiversity.
assumption: Traditional irrigation channels maintain biodiversity.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para regar por inundación necesitas una nivelación del suelo.” For flood irrigation, you need soil leveling.
quote_es: Para regar por inundación necesitas una nivelación del suelo.
quote_en: For flood irrigation, you need soil leveling.
assumption: Proper flood irrigation requires leveled ground in your plot.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si la tabla es más pequeña se reduce la exposición del suelo al sol.” If the plot section is smaller, soil exposure to the sun is reduced.
quote_es: Si la tabla es más pequeña se reduce la exposición del suelo al sol.
quote_en: If the plot section is smaller, soil exposure to the sun is reduced.
assumption: Reducing the distance among trees can reduce sun exposure to the soil.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Libre de malas hierbas: menos competencia, menos consumo de agua. Puedes espaciar el tiempo entre riegos.” Weed-free: less competition, less water consumption. You can space out irrigation turns.
quote_es: Libre de malas hierbas: menos competencia, menos consumo de agua. Puedes espaciar el tiempo entre riegos.
quote_en: Weed-free: less competition, less water consumption. You can space out irrigation turns.
assumption: In weed-free crops, all water consumption goes to the plantation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando se forma un ’tollo’ el agua se pierde por ahí, hay que meter la mano y tapar el hueco.” When a hole is formed, water is lost through it; you must put your hand in and seal the gap.
quote_es: Cuando se forma un ’tollo’ el agua se pierde por ahí, hay que meter la mano y tapar el hueco.
quote_en: When a hole is formed, water is lost through it; you must put your hand in and seal the gap.
assumption: Repair of plot terraces is needed to prevent water loss.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si a la arbolea no le hace falta, es matarla.” If the tree does not need it, irrigating is killing it.
quote_es: Si a la arbolea no le hace falta, es matarla.
quote_en: If the tree does not need it, irrigating is killing it.
assumption: Overwatering the crop negatively affects its development.

traditional_knowledge: ”En verano la tierra se calienta.” In summer, the soil heats up.
quote_es: En verano la tierra se calienta.
quote_en: In summer, the soil heats up.
assumption: In summer, soil temperature rises.

traditional_knowledge: ”Mantener la hierba segada en el suelo de la parcela hace que se guarde la humedad en el suelo.” Keeping mowed weeds on the plot ground helps retain soil moisture.
quote_es: Mantener la hierba segada en el suelo de la parcela hace que se guarde la humedad en el suelo.
quote_en: Keeping mowed weeds on the plot ground helps retain soil moisture.
assumption: Keeping mowed weeds on the ground maintains soil humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las grietas que se forman en el suelo con las temporadas secas hacen que la tierra se seque antes.” The cracks that form in the soil during dry seasons make the soil dry out faster.
quote_es: Las grietas que se forman en el suelo con las temporadas secas hacen que la tierra se seque antes.
quote_en: The cracks that form in the soil during dry seasons make the soil dry out faster.
assumption: Soil cracking during dry seasons accelerates moisture loss.

traditional_knowledge: ”La tierra arada mantiene mejor la humedad.” Plowed soil retains moisture better.
quote_es: La tierra arada mantiene mejor la humedad.
quote_en: Plowed soil retains moisture better.
assumption: Plowed soil improves moisture retention.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los plásticos sobre los cultivos ayudan a mantener la humedad del suelo.” Plastic over crops helps maintain soil moisture.
quote_es: Los plásticos sobre los cultivos ayudan a mantener la humedad del suelo.
quote_en: Plastic over crops helps maintain soil moisture.
assumption: Plastic mulching reduces soil moisture loss.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los terrenos yesíferos son malos para cultivar regadío.” Gypsum soils are bad for irrigated crops.
quote_es: Los terrenos yesíferos son malos para cultivar regadío.
quote_en: Gypsum soils are bad for irrigated crops.
assumption: Gypsum soils are not suited for irrigated crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los terrenos con tierras negras y flojas son buenos para cultivar.” Dark and loose soils are good for cultivating.
quote_es: Los terrenos con tierras negras y flojas son buenos para cultivar.
quote_en: Dark and loose soils are good for cultivating.
assumption: Dark and loose soils are good for cultivating.

traditional_knowledge: ”Arar evita que se formen grietas en la tierra.” Plowing prevents cracks from forming in the soil.
quote_es: Arar evita que se formen grietas en la tierra.
quote_en: Plowing prevents cracks from forming in the soil.
assumption: Plowing helps delay humidity loss in the soil.

traditional_knowledge: ”Para conocer la calidad del suelo para cultivar debes fijarte en el color de la tierra.” To know the quality of the soil for cultivation, you must look at the color of the earth.
quote_es: Para conocer la calidad del suelo para cultivar debes fijarte en el color de la tierra.
quote_en: To know the quality of the soil for cultivation, you must look at the color of the earth.
assumption: Soil color indicates its suitability for growing.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las tierras cerca de ríos tienen más aporte hídrico y son más productivas.” Lands near rivers have more water supply and are more productive.
quote_es: Las tierras cerca de ríos tienen más aporte hídrico y son más productivas.
quote_en: Lands near rivers have more water supply and are more productive.
assumption: Croplands near rivers have more water supply and are more productive.

traditional_knowledge: ”Plantar los limoneros a 3 o 4 metros reduce la evaporación; a más metros, más aumenta.” Planting lemon trees 3 or 4 meters apart reduces evaporation; the more distance, the more it increases.
quote_es: Plantar los limoneros a 3 o 4 metros reduce la evaporación; a más metros, más aumenta.
quote_en: Planting lemon trees 3 or 4 meters apart reduces evaporation; the more distance, the more it increases.
assumption: Reducing the distance among trees reduces water evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los suelos salinos son muy poco fértiles.” Saline soils are not very fertile.
quote_es: Los suelos salinos son muy poco fértiles.
quote_en: Saline soils are not very fertile.
assumption: Saline soils have limited fertility.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuanta más humedad, más enfermedades de hongos.” The more moisture, the more fungal diseases.
quote_es: Cuanta más humedad, más enfermedades de hongos.
quote_en: The more moisture, the more fungal diseases.
assumption: Fungal diseases occur in highly moisturized soils.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si tengo una tierra esponjosa, levanto el tablacho una vez al mes. Con una tierra más dura la levanto cada 20 días.” If I have porous soil, I irrigate once a month. With harder soil, I irrigate every 20 days.
quote_es: Si tengo una tierra esponjosa, levanto el tablacho una vez al mes. Con una tierra más dura la levanto cada 20 días.
quote_en: If I have porous soil, I irrigate once a month. With harder soil, I irrigate every 20 days.
assumption: Soil compactness influences how often you irrigate.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando la tierra es muy arenosa el agua se va al subsuelo y se pierde.” When the soil is very sandy, water goes to the subsoil and is lost.
quote_es: Cuando la tierra es muy arenosa el agua se va al subsuelo y se pierde.
quote_en: When the soil is very sandy, water goes to the subsoil and is lost.
assumption: Water percolates deepest in sandy soils.

traditional_knowledge: ”Se dan azadazos para ver si salen terrones secos.” You hit the ground with a hoe to see if dry clods come out. A dry clod means lack of humidity.
quote_es: Se dan azadazos para ver si salen terrones secos.
quote_en: You hit the ground with a hoe to see if dry clods come out. A dry clod means lack of humidity.
assumption: Soil humidity can be tested at any time.

traditional_knowledge: ”La hojarasca del árbol se deja en el suelo para evitar la evaporación.” Tree leaf litter is left on the ground to prevent evaporation.
quote_es: La hojarasca del árbol se deja en el suelo para evitar la evaporación.
quote_en: Tree leaf litter is left on the ground to prevent evaporation.
assumption: Fallen leaves help keep soil moist.

traditional_knowledge: ”Labrando se mantiene la humedad en el suelo, incluso en profundidad.” By plowing, you maintain soil moisture, even at depth.
quote_es: Labrando se mantiene la humedad en el suelo, incluso en profundidad.
quote_en: By plowing, you maintain soil moisture, even at depth.
assumption: Plowing helps retain soil humidity even in deep layers.

traditional_knowledge: ”La parte pegada al río tiene mejor sedimento.” The part next to the river has better sediment.
quote_es: La parte pegada al río tiene mejor sedimento.
quote_en: The part next to the river has better sediment.
