assumption: Plots located near river sides have better sediments.

traditional_knowledge: ”La ’media luna’ y el ’vinagrillo’ atrapan la humedad en el suelo.” The ’media luna’ and ’vinagrillo’ (different flower plants) trap moisture in the soil.
quote_es: La ’media luna’ y el ’vinagrillo’ atrapan la humedad en el suelo.
quote_en: The ’media luna’ and ’vinagrillo’ (different flower plants) trap moisture in the soil.
assumption: Some flower species can help keep soil humidity.

traditional_knowledge: ”En verano se utiliza más agua.” In summer, more water is used.
quote_es: En verano se utiliza más agua.
quote_en: In summer, more water is used.
assumption: During summer periods, water consumption rises.

traditional_knowledge: ”El mejor momento para transplantar el plantón a la tierra es final de invierno y principios de la primavera, así no le afecta el frío.” The best time to transplant a sapling to the soil is the end of winter and the beginning of spring, so that the cold does not affect it.
quote_es: El mejor momento para transplantar el plantón a la tierra es final de invierno y principios de la primavera, así no le afecta el frío.
quote_en: The best time to transplant a sapling to the soil is the end of winter and the beginning of spring, so that the cold does not affect it.
assumption: Saplings should be transplanted between the end of winter and the beginning of spring.

traditional_knowledge: ”En un contexto de sequía, se reduce el tamaño de la tabla, se pegan los caballones al tallo.” In a drought context, the size of the plot section is reduced, and ridges are brought closer to the stem.
quote_es: En un contexto de sequía, se reduce el tamaño de la tabla, se pegan los caballones al tallo.
quote_en: In a drought context, the size of the plot section is reduced, and ridges are brought closer to the stem.
assumption: In a drought, the space between ridges is reduced to minimize the amount of water used.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay sequía corto el agua en cuanto llega a la cola.” If there is drought, I cut off the water as soon as it reaches the bottom of the plot.
quote_es: Si hay sequía corto el agua en cuanto llega a la cola.
quote_en: If there is drought, I cut off the water as soon as it reaches the bottom of the plot.
assumption: In a drought, watering time is reduced.

traditional_knowledge: ”En el engorde del fruto, prestas atención a que no le falte agua, también en verano.” During fruit fattening, you pay attention to ensure it does not lack water, also in summer.
quote_es: En el engorde del fruto, prestas atención a que no le falte agua, también en verano.
quote_en: During fruit fattening, you pay attention to ensure it does not lack water, also in summer.
assumption: Water stress peaks during the fattening phase and summer season.

traditional_knowledge: ”La humedad en el suelo se mantiene en días nubosos y de lluvia.” Soil moisture is maintained on cloudy and rainy days.
quote_es: La humedad en el suelo se mantiene en días nubosos y de lluvia.
quote_en: Soil moisture is maintained on cloudy and rainy days.
assumption: Soil moisture is maintained on cloudy and rainy days.

traditional_knowledge: ”En el verano los riegos son menos espaciados en el tiempo.” In summer, irrigation intervals are shorter.
quote_es: En el verano los riegos son menos espaciados en el tiempo.
quote_en: In summer, irrigation intervals are shorter.
assumption: During summer, irrigation is less spaced in time.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando el agua escasea hay que evitar plantaciones (en vez de patatas, plantas otras cosas, o usas menos terreno), porque no puedes cambiar los cultivos establecidos (limoneros, etc).” When water is scarce, avoid plantings (instead of potatoes, plant other things, or use less land), because you cannot change established crops (lemon trees, etc.).
quote_es: Cuando el agua escasea hay que evitar plantaciones (en vez de patatas, plantas otras cosas, o usas menos terreno), porque no puedes cambiar los cultivos establecidos (limoneros, etc).
quote_en: When water is scarce, avoid plantings (instead of potatoes, plant other things, or use less land), because you cannot change established crops (lemon trees, etc.).
assumption: During water scarcity, perennial crops constrain flexibility; adaptation must focus on reducing new or seasonal plantings.

traditional_knowledge: ”Decido cuánta agua meter mirando el cultivo: cómo de marchita está la planta, cómo de arrugadas están las hojas, escarbo para ver si sus raíces tienen agua.” I decide how much water to apply by looking at the crop: how wilted the plant is, how wrinkled the leaves are, I dig to see if its roots have water.
quote_es: Decido cuánta agua meter mirando el cultivo: cómo de marchita está la planta, cómo de arrugadas están las hojas, escarbo para ver si sus raíces tienen agua.
quote_en: I decide how much water to apply by looking at the crop: how wilted the plant is, how wrinkled the leaves are, I dig to see if its roots have water.
assumption: Visual and tactile observation of plant and soil conditions provides information for irrigation decisions.

traditional_knowledge: Saying- ”Si quieres tener un buen habar, siembra por la Virgen del Pilar.” If you want to have a good bean crop, sow on the Virgin of Pilar’s day.
quote_es: Si quieres tener un buen habar, siembra por la Virgen del Pilar.
quote_en: If you want to have a good bean crop, sow on the Virgin of Pilar’s day.
assumption: Calendars based on saints’ days reflect favorable patterns for germination.

traditional_knowledge: ”Algunos cultivos requieren ser regados hasta arriba, otros sólo hasta la mitad.” Some crops need to be watered to the top, others only halfway.
quote_es: Algunos cultivos requieren ser regados hasta arriba, otros sólo hasta la mitad.
quote_en: Some crops need to be watered to the top, others only halfway.
assumption: Different crops require different irrigation depths.

traditional_knowledge: ”Tapamos con maleza el cultivo para que el agua no se evapore tan rápido.” We cover the crop with weeds so the water doesn’t evaporate so quickly.
quote_es: Tapamos con maleza el cultivo para que el agua no se evapore tan rápido.
quote_en: We cover the crop with weeds so the water doesn’t evaporate so quickly.
assumption: Adding plant cover helps reduce water evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Con hortalizas inundamos hasta la mitad del caballón.” With vegetables, we flood up to half the ridge.
quote_es: Con hortalizas inundamos hasta la mitad del caballón.
quote_en: With vegetables, we flood up to half the ridge.
assumption: Irrigation depth depends on crop type.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando se riega hortalizas hay que regar lo justo, con los árboles hay más margen.” When watering vegetables, you have to water just enough; with trees, there is more leeway.
quote_es: Cuando se riega hortalizas hay que regar lo justo, con los árboles hay más margen.
quote_en: When watering vegetables, you have to water just enough; with trees, there is more leeway.
assumption: Different plants have different water needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”En Abril que no te vea salir” (sobre el panizo, porque se sembraba en Marzo y debía salir en Junio; si salía en Abril se podía helar). In April, may it not see you emerge (about millet, because it was sown in March and should emerge in June; if it emerged in April, it could freeze).
quote_es: En Abril que no te vea salir
quote_en: (sobre el panizo, porque se sembraba en Marzo y debía salir en Junio; si salía en Abril se podía helar). In April, may it not see you emerge (about millet, because it was sown in March and should emerge in June; if it emerged in April, it could freeze).
assumption: Growth should follow natural rhythms to avoid risks.

traditional_knowledge: ”En Abril, como un hilín” (cuanto más fino era el cebollino, mejor para crecer). In April, like a thin thread (the thinner the chive, the better for growing).
quote_es: En Abril, como un hilín
quote_en: (cuanto más fino era el cebollino, mejor para crecer). In April, like a thin thread (the thinner the chive, the better for growing).
assumption: The shape of a crop may indicate its growth capacity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Lo único que cambia respecto al tipo de cultivo es la frecuencia con la que uno riega.” The only thing that changes with the type of crop is the frequency with which one waters.
quote_es: Lo único que cambia respecto al tipo de cultivo es la frecuencia con la que uno riega.
quote_en: The only thing that changes with the type of crop is the frequency with which one waters.
assumption: Irrigation frequency depends on the crop, not on fixed timing.

traditional_knowledge: ”No se sabe el agua que necesita un cultivo; tienes que estar pendiente de él.” You don’t know how much water a crop needs; you have to pay attention to it.
quote_es: No se sabe el agua que necesita un cultivo; tienes que estar pendiente de él.
quote_en: You don’t know how much water a crop needs; you have to pay attention to it.
assumption: The water needs of a crop must be read from the crop itself and cannot be measured in advance.

traditional_knowledge: ”Con el cilantro y el perejil el primer riego tiene que cubrir el cultivo, el segundo no.” With coriander and parsley, the first watering must cover the crop, the second one not.
quote_es: Con el cilantro y el perejil el primer riego tiene que cubrir el cultivo, el segundo no.
quote_en: With coriander and parsley, the first watering must cover the crop, the second one not.
assumption: Watering patterns for some crops must be adjusted to their growth stage.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cambiando de cultivos se mejora la amargura de la tierra.” Changing crops improves the bitterness of the soil.
quote_es: Cambiando de cultivos se mejora la amargura de la tierra.
quote_en: Changing crops improves the bitterness of the soil.
assumption: Crop rotation improves soil health.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hace aire y se ha plantado perejil o cilantro, se hace un riego rápido para ablandar el suelo y que la semilla pueda romper la costra.” If it is windy and parsley or coriander has been planted, a quick irrigation is done to soften the soil so the seed can break the crust.
quote_es: Si hace aire y se ha plantado perejil o cilantro, se hace un riego rápido para ablandar el suelo y que la semilla pueda romper la costra.
quote_en: If it is windy and parsley or coriander has been planted, a quick irrigation is done to soften the soil so the seed can break the crust.
assumption: Swift irrigation can sort out the soil crusting caused by wind and help the seedling emerge.

traditional_knowledge: ”Agua en mayo quita aceite y no da grano.” Rain in May removes oil and does not yield grain.
quote_es: Agua en mayo quita aceite y no da grano.
quote_en: Rain in May removes oil and does not yield grain.
assumption: Rain can be detrimental to olive trees and grain if out of season.

traditional_knowledge: ”No siembres tu viña al lado del camino porque todo el que pasa coge un racimo.” Do not plant your vineyard next to the path because everyone who passes by takes a bunch.
quote_es: No siembres tu viña al lado del camino porque todo el que pasa coge un racimo.
quote_en: Do not plant your vineyard next to the path because everyone who passes by takes a bunch.
assumption: Some crops must not be planted near public pathways.

traditional_knowledge: ”El limón que tiene sed lo muestra por la tarde.” The lemon tree that is thirsty shows it in the afternoon.
quote_es: El limón que tiene sed lo muestra por la tarde.
quote_en: The lemon tree that is thirsty shows it in the afternoon.
assumption: Crop water needs are better assessed in the afternoon.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cortábamos morera para dársela a los animales para comer.” We cut mulberry to feed the animals.
quote_es: Cortábamos morera para dársela a los animales para comer.
quote_en: We cut mulberry to feed the animals.
assumption: Irrigation and livestock management are connected.

traditional_knowledge: ”Las malvas son buenas para el riñón, las ortigas son buenas para depurar el estómago.” Mallows are good for the kidneys, nettles are good for cleansing the stomach.
quote_es: Las malvas son buenas para el riñón, las ortigas son buenas para depurar el estómago.
quote_en: Mallows are good for the kidneys, nettles are good for cleansing the stomach.
assumption: Weeds have medicinal value.

traditional_knowledge: ”El jugo de limón se utilizaba para higienizar el serrucho y para quitar espinas y puntas de las manos después de trabajar en el limonero.” Lemon juice was used to sanitize the pruning saw and to remove thorns and splinters from hands after working on the lemon tree.
quote_es: El jugo de limón se utilizaba para higienizar el serrucho y para quitar espinas y puntas de las manos después de trabajar en el limonero.
quote_en: Lemon juice was used to sanitize the pruning saw and to remove thorns and splinters from hands after working on the lemon tree.
assumption: Lemon juice has cleansing and disinfecting properties.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay sequía, en vez de tener hortalizas todo el año las tienes medio año y así riegas menos.” When there is drought, instead of having vegetables all year, you have them half the year and thus you water less.
quote_es: Cuando hay sequía, en vez de tener hortalizas todo el año las tienes medio año y así riegas menos.
quote_en: When there is drought, instead of having vegetables all year, you have them half the year and thus you water less.
assumption: Crop patterns should adapt to water availability.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Reutilizamos aguas ’vivas’ en aguas ’muertas’, que luego se re-canalizan en aguas ’vivas’ otra vez. No se pierde nada de agua.” We reuse ’live’ waters as ’dead’ waters, which are then re-channeled into ’live’ waters again. No water is lost.
quote_es: Reutilizamos aguas ’vivas’ en aguas ’muertas’, que luego se re-canalizan en aguas ’vivas’ otra vez. No se pierde nada de agua.
quote_en: We reuse ’live’ waters as ’dead’ waters, which are then re-channeled into ’live’ waters again. No water is lost.
assumption: Water circulates within a closed irrigation system where reuse and recirculation prevent losses.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Mirando dónde vuelan las garzas sabemos por qué acequia y por dónde pasa el agua (las garzas siguen a los bichos, que se van donde va el agua).” By looking at where the herons fly, we know which ditch and where the water flows (herons follow the insects, which go where the water goes).
quote_es: Mirando dónde vuelan las garzas sabemos por qué acequia y por dónde pasa el agua (las garzas siguen a los bichos, que se van donde va el agua).
quote_en: By looking at where the herons fly, we know which ditch and where the water flows (herons follow the insects, which go where the water goes).
assumption: Heron flight patterns serve as an indicator of water flow and distribution.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay poca agua cavo zanjas para dirigir el agua directamente al limonero, sin inundar.” When there is little water, I dig trenches to direct water straight to the lemon tree, without flooding.
quote_es: Cuando hay poca agua cavo zanjas para dirigir el agua directamente al limonero, sin inundar.
quote_en: When there is little water, I dig trenches to direct water straight to the lemon tree, without flooding.
assumption: Channeling water directly to the lemon tree (without flooding) improves water efficiency during water shortages.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”No medimos los litros de agua sino el tiempo que se tarda en regar.” We do not measure liters of water but the time it takes to irrigate.
quote_es: No medimos los litros de agua sino el tiempo que se tarda en regar.
quote_en: We do not measure liters of water but the time it takes to irrigate.
assumption: Irrigation control is based on timing rather than quantitative water measurement.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes se cortaba el agua antes de que llegara al final del bancal porque la misma fuerza del agua hacía que se empujara a sí misma y llegara de todas formas.” Before, water was cut off before reaching the end of the plot because the force of the water itself pushed it forward and it still arrived.
quote_es: Antes se cortaba el agua antes de que llegara al final del bancal porque la misma fuerza del agua hacía que se empujara a sí misma y llegara de todas formas.
quote_en: Before, water was cut off before reaching the end of the plot because the force of the water itself pushed it forward and it still arrived.
assumption: Taking advantage of water flow momentum enables water savings without reducing irrigation coverage.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay mucha sequía, dejo correr el agua por la parcela un poco más.” If there is severe drought, I let the water run through the plot a little longer.
quote_es: Si hay mucha sequía, dejo correr el agua por la parcela un poco más.
quote_en: If there is severe drought, I let the water run through the plot a little longer.
assumption: Allowing water to flow longer during drought improves soil moisture storage.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay sequía hago tablas pequeñas para aprovechar mejor el agua.” When there is drought, I make small plots to make better use of the water.
quote_es: Cuando hay sequía hago tablas pequeñas para aprovechar mejor el agua.
quote_en: When there is drought, I make small plots to make better use of the water.
assumption: During drought, shrinking the part of the plot that is irrigated helps make the most of the water available.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay sequía limpio más, estoy más pendiente y dialogo más con los regantes para que estén atentos y no pierdan agua.” When there is drought, I clean more, I pay more attention, and I talk more with other irrigators so they are attentive and do not waste water.
quote_es: Cuando hay sequía limpio más, estoy más pendiente y dialogo más con los regantes para que estén atentos y no pierdan agua.
quote_en: When there is drought, I clean more, I pay more attention, and I talk more with other irrigators so they are attentive and do not waste water.
assumption: Increased care, maintenance, and coordination among irrigators can mitigate the effects of drought.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La solidaridad es fundamental en la huerta.” Solidarity is fundamental in the orchard.
quote_es: La solidaridad es fundamental en la huerta.
quote_en: Solidarity is fundamental in the orchard.
assumption: Successful irrigation depends on collaboration and cohesion.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes sembrabas alfalfa, regabas y los pajaritos de las nieves venían para comerse los bichos que salían.” Before, you sowed alfalfa, irrigated, and the snow birds came to eat the insects that emerged.
quote_es: Antes sembrabas alfalfa, regabas y los pajaritos de las nieves venían para comerse los bichos que salían.
quote_en: Before, you sowed alfalfa, irrigated, and the snow birds came to eat the insects that emerged.
assumption: Irrigation practices are interconnected with ecological processes.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si me puedo ahorrar un riego, me lo ahorro.” If I can save an irrigation, I save it.
quote_es: Si me puedo ahorrar un riego, me lo ahorro.
quote_en: If I can save an irrigation, I save it.
assumption: Water and labor are valuable and should be used prudently.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cambiar el riego tradicional es un suicidio; yo lo defendería a toda costa.” Changing traditional irrigation is suicide; I would defend it at all costs.
quote_es: Cambiar el riego tradicional es un suicidio; yo lo defendería a toda costa.
quote_en: Changing traditional irrigation is suicide; I would defend it at all costs.
assumption: Traditional irrigation is essential to the survival of irrigators.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para saber si una parcela necesita agua tienes que ir a verla al mediodía, no por la mañana.” To know if a plot needs water, you have to go see it at noon, not in the morning.
quote_es: Para saber si una parcela necesita agua tienes que ir a verla al mediodía, no por la mañana.
quote_en: To know if a plot needs water, you have to go see it at noon, not in the morning.
assumption: Signs of water stress are reliable only in specific periods of the day.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando hay sequía hacemos unos caballones para regar la parte de los árboles solo.” When there is drought, we make ridges to water only the tree part.
quote_es: Cuando hay sequía hacemos unos caballones para regar la parte de los árboles solo.
quote_en: When there is drought, we make ridges to water only the tree part.
assumption: Water scarcity requires adaptive irrigation practices to target water where it matters most.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando había sequía también hacíamos un pozo en la acequia, el agua se acumulaba, metíamos una ceña para sacarla y regar aquella zona.” When there was drought, we also made a well in the ditch, the water accumulated, we put a pole to lift it and irrigate that area.
quote_es: Cuando había sequía también hacíamos un pozo en la acequia, el agua se acumulaba, metíamos una ceña para sacarla y regar aquella zona.
quote_en: When there was drought, we also made a well in the ditch, the water accumulated, we put a pole to lift it and irrigate that area.
assumption: Resilience to drought comes from local ingenuity and adaptive practices.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando había sequía hacíamos pozos para regar con agua subterránea, sabíamos que era mala agua pero la utilizábamos igual.” When there was drought, we made wells to irrigate with groundwater; we knew it was poorquality water but we used it anyway.
quote_es: Cuando había sequía hacíamos pozos para regar con agua subterránea, sabíamos que era mala agua pero la utilizábamos igual.
quote_en: When there was drought, we made wells to irrigate with groundwater; we knew it was poorquality water but we used it anyway.
assumption: Under water scarcity, maintaining crops justifies using lower-quality water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Presencia de ranas y culebrinas en los escorredores significa que el agua y el hábitat era bueno.” The presence of frogs and small snakes in the drainage channels means the water and habitat were good.
quote_es: Presencia de ranas y culebrinas en los escorredores significa que el agua y el hábitat era bueno.
quote_en: The presence of frogs and small snakes in the drainage channels means the water and habitat were good.
assumption: Frogs and snakes in drainage channels indicate ecological well-being.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Con el goteo las raíces van hacia arriba y por tanto no se pueden arar los suelos.” With drip irrigation, roots grow upward and therefore soils cannot be plowed.
quote_es: Con el goteo las raíces van hacia arriba y por tanto no se pueden arar los suelos.
quote_en: With drip irrigation, roots grow upward and therefore soils cannot be plowed.
assumption: Irrigation method shapes root behavior.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El agua es fría, pero es muy caliente cuando te la quitan.” Water is cold, but it is very hot when taken away from you.
quote_es: El agua es fría, pero es muy caliente cuando te la quitan.
quote_en: Water is cold, but it is very hot when taken away from you.
assumption: Water theft sparks serious conflicts.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Durante sequías se cogían las aguas sobrantes del ’merancho’ y se subían a la acequia principal con aceñas o bombas.” During droughts, leftover water from the ’merancho’ was collected and raised to the main ditch with waterwheels or pumps.
quote_es: Durante sequías se cogían las aguas sobrantes del ’merancho’ y se subían a la acequia principal con aceñas o bombas.
quote_en: During droughts, leftover water from the ’merancho’ was collected and raised to the main ditch with waterwheels or pumps.
assumption: Water is a reusable resource.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Para que la parcela se inunde un dedo al final, tiene que inundarse 4-5 dedos al principio.” For the plot to be flooded one finger deep at the end, it must be flooded 4-5 fingers deep at the beginning.
quote_es: Para que la parcela se inunde un dedo al final, tiene que inundarse 4-5 dedos al principio.
quote_en: For the plot to be flooded one finger deep at the end, it must be flooded 4-5 fingers deep at the beginning.
assumption: Water application must be deeper closer to the channel so that extra water reaches the end of the plot by gravity.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Con vinagrillo en la parcela tardas más en regar.” With oxalis weeds in the plot, you take longer to irrigate.
quote_es: Con vinagrillo en la parcela tardas más en regar.
quote_en: With oxalis weeds in the plot, you take longer to irrigate.
assumption: Irrigation in plots with weeds requires more time.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Antes los viejos no desperdiciaban ninguna gota de agua.” In the past, the old folks did not waste a single drop of water.
quote_es: Antes los viejos no desperdiciaban ninguna gota de agua.
quote_en: In the past, the old folks did not waste a single drop of water.
assumption: Senior irrigators were highly water efficient.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando el agua corre mucho lo arrastra todo, pero es peor que el agua no ande porque se hace un tapón.” When water runs too fast, it drags everything, but it is worse if the water does not move because it creates a blockage.
quote_es: Cuando el agua corre mucho lo arrastra todo, pero es peor que el agua no ande porque se hace un tapón.
quote_en: When water runs too fast, it drags everything, but it is worse if the water does not move because it creates a blockage.
assumption: The pace of water in channels and plots should be appropriate.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”En la huerta se funciona ’a vuelta de peonada’: hoy yo te ayudo a ti y mañana tú me ayudas a mí.” In the orchard, it works on a ’day-labor exchange’: today I help you, and tomorrow you help me.
quote_es: En la huerta se funciona ’a vuelta de peonada’: hoy yo te ayudo a ti y mañana tú me ayudas a mí.
quote_en: In the orchard, it works on a ’day-labor exchange’: today I help you, and tomorrow you help me.
assumption: Irrigation relies on reciprocity.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”No matábamos las culebras porque se comían los topillos y los ratones; también se dejaban las lagartijas.” We did not kill snakes because they ate voles and mice; we also left the lizards.
quote_es: No matábamos las culebras porque se comían los topillos y los ratones; también se dejaban las lagartijas.
quote_en: We did not kill snakes because they ate voles and mice; we also left the lizards.
assumption: Some animals can help control pests.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La Confederación marca la cantidad de agua disponible cada año, nosotros la distribuimos por las acequias.” The Water Confederation sets the amount of water available each year, and we distribute it through the ditches.
quote_es: La Confederación marca la cantidad de agua disponible cada año, nosotros la distribuimos por las acequias.
quote_en: The Water Confederation sets the amount of water available each year, and we distribute it through the ditches.
assumption: Water governance combines external regulations and local management.

traditional_knowledge: ”Tierras más ’fuertes’ guardan mejor el agua que las tierras arenosas, que necesitan riego más a menudo. La tierra ’glea’ (de color gris) es la peor.” Stronger (clayey) soils retain water better than sandy soils, which need more frequent irrigation. ’Glea’ soil (grayish) is the worst.
quote_es: Tierras más ’fuertes’ guardan mejor el agua que las tierras arenosas, que necesitan riego más a menudo. La tierra ’glea’ (de color gris) es la peor.
quote_en: Stronger (clayey) soils retain water better than sandy soils, which need more frequent irrigation. ’Glea’ soil (grayish) is the worst.
assumption: Soil texture and color can determine water retention capacity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Suelos arenosos son buenos para el cultivo pero se secan más rápido.” Sandy soils are good for crops but dry out faster.
quote_es: Suelos arenosos son buenos para el cultivo pero se secan más rápido.
quote_en: Sandy soils are good for crops but dry out faster.
assumption: Soils that favor plant growth (loose, wellaerated) lose moisture more quickly.

traditional_knowledge: ”Sé si el suelo está húmedo dándole un golpe con la azada.” I know if the soil is wet by hitting it with a hoe.
quote_es: Sé si el suelo está húmedo dándole un golpe con la azada.
quote_en: I know if the soil is wet by hitting it with a hoe.
assumption: The physical resistance and sound of the soil, when struck, informs its moisture content.

traditional_knowledge: ”Los mejores suelos son los arenosos porque mantienen la humedad debajo mucho mejor.” The best soils are sandy because they retain moisture underneath much better.
quote_es: Los mejores suelos son los arenosos porque mantienen la humedad debajo mucho mejor.
quote_en: The best soils are sandy because they retain moisture underneath much better.
assumption: Good soil preserves subsurface moisture, even if the surface appears dry.

traditional_knowledge: ”El vinagrillo crece alrededor de los árboles; por la noche el rocío baja a la tierra y el vinagrillo almacena la humedad y es bueno para la tierra.” Oxalis grows around trees; at night the dew falls to the ground and oxalis stores moisture and is good for the soil.
quote_es: El vinagrillo crece alrededor de los árboles; por la noche el rocío baja a la tierra y el vinagrillo almacena la humedad y es bueno para la tierra.
quote_en: Oxalis grows around trees; at night the dew falls to the ground and oxalis stores moisture and is good for the soil.
assumption: Specific weeds help retain environmental moisture and contribute to soil health.

traditional_knowledge: ”Antes se tiraba estiércol para preservar la humedad del suelo y darle fuerza.” In the past, manure was spread to preserve soil moisture and give it strength.
quote_es: Antes se tiraba estiércol para preservar la humedad del suelo y darle fuerza.
quote_en: In the past, manure was spread to preserve soil moisture and give it strength.
assumption: Organic matter improves the soil’s moisture retention capacity.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando aras crece más hierba y tardas más tiempo en regar.” When you plow, more weeds grow and you take longer to irrigate.
quote_es: Cuando aras crece más hierba y tardas más tiempo en regar.
quote_en: When you plow, more weeds grow and you take longer to irrigate.
assumption: Soil disturbance by plowing alters both vegetation dynamics and water behavior.

traditional_knowledge: ”Dejar trozos con hierba puede ser bueno porque los bichos van ahí y no al limonero.” Leaving patches with weeds can be good because the insects go there and not to the lemon tree.
quote_es: Dejar trozos con hierba puede ser bueno porque los bichos van ahí y no al limonero.
quote_en: Leaving patches with weeds can be good because the insects go there and not to the lemon tree.
assumption: Maintaining weedy vegetation helps regulate pests by diverting them away from crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”Un buen suelo drena rápido y al cabo de una hora ya no tiene agua.” Good soil drains quickly and after an hour no longer has water.
quote_es: Un buen suelo drena rápido y al cabo de una hora ya no tiene agua.
quote_en: Good soil drains quickly and after an hour no longer has water.
assumption: Soil quality depends on its capacity to absorb and release water swiftly.

traditional_knowledge: ”Tierras fuertes son más buenas para las hortalizas; tierras arenosas son más buenas para el arbolado.” Strong (clayey) soils are better for vegetables; sandy soils are better for trees.
quote_es: Tierras fuertes son más buenas para las hortalizas; tierras arenosas son más buenas para el arbolado.
quote_en: Strong (clayey) soils are better for vegetables; sandy soils are better for trees.
assumption: Soil quality is relative to crop type.

traditional_knowledge: ”Algunas personas piensan que cuando sale la lombriz, va a llover.” Some people think that when earthworms emerge, it is going to rain.
quote_es: Algunas personas piensan que cuando sale la lombriz, va a llover.
quote_en: Some people think that when earthworms emerge, it is going to rain.
assumption: Insect behavior may help predict rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hay humedad en el suelo no riego.” If there is moisture in the soil, I do not irrigate.
quote_es: Si hay humedad en el suelo no riego.
quote_en: If there is moisture in the soil, I do not irrigate.
assumption: Soil humidity can be used to assess water needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si escarbamos el suelo y vemos que la tierra sigue amarilla, está muy seca.” If we dig the soil and see that it is still yellow, it is very dry.
quote_es: Si escarbamos el suelo y vemos que la tierra sigue amarilla, está muy seca.
quote_en: If we dig the soil and see that it is still yellow, it is very dry.
assumption: Soil color informs on water needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”El agua del cielo no quita riego.” Rain from the sky does not cancel irrigation.
quote_es: El agua del cielo no quita riego.
quote_en: Rain from the sky does not cancel irrigation.
assumption: Irrigation must be done regardless of rainfall patterns.

traditional_knowledge: ”El agua del cielo no quita riego a las hortalizas pero al arbolado sí puede quitar algún riego (el árbol no necesita tanta agua).” Rain from the sky does not cancel irrigation for vegetables, but for trees it may cancel some irrigation (the tree does not need as much water).
quote_es: El agua del cielo no quita riego a las hortalizas pero al arbolado sí puede quitar algún riego (el árbol no necesita tanta agua).
quote_en: Rain from the sky does not cancel irrigation for vegetables, but for trees it may cancel some irrigation (the tree does not need as much water).
assumption: Tree crops do not require as much water as vegetable crops.

traditional_knowledge: ”No se puede prever la lluvia demasiado bien.” Rain cannot be predicted very well.
quote_es: No se puede prever la lluvia demasiado bien.
quote_en: Rain cannot be predicted very well.
assumption: Rainfall cannot be predicted with accuracy.

traditional_knowledge: ”El gallo cantaba cuando estaba el cielo muy negro, señal de que iba a llover.” The rooster crowed when the sky was very dark, a sign that it was going to rain.
quote_es: El gallo cantaba cuando estaba el cielo muy negro, señal de que iba a llover.
quote_en: The rooster crowed when the sky was very dark, a sign that it was going to rain.
assumption: The rooster’s crowing can be used to predict rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: ”El olor a humedad indica lluvia.” The smell of humidity indicates rain.
quote_es: El olor a humedad indica lluvia.
quote_en: The smell of humidity indicates rain.
assumption: Humid smells in the air indicate rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando el sol se pone blanquinoso, se dice ’está el sol de lluvia’.” When the sun sets whitish, it is said ’the sun is rainy’.
quote_es: Cuando el sol se pone blanquinoso, se dice ’está el sol de lluvia’.
quote_en: When the sun sets whitish, it is said ’the sun is rainy’.
assumption: Visual changes in sunlight serve as indicators of approaching rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”El aire de levante favorece las cosechas, el del sur no.” Easterly wind favors crops, southerly wind does not.
quote_es: El aire de levante favorece las cosechas, el del sur no.
quote_en: Easterly wind favors crops, southerly wind does not.
assumption: Different wind directions bring distinct climatic conditions that affect crop performance.

traditional_knowledge: ”El cambio climático ha adelantado la cosecha un mes y medio.” Climate change has advanced the harvest by a month and a half.
quote_es: El cambio climático ha adelantado la cosecha un mes y medio.
quote_en: Climate change has advanced the harvest by a month and a half.
assumption: Climate changes are visibly altering harvesting patterns.

traditional_knowledge: ”Mi padre miraba las estrellas de noche para saber si iba a perder la cosecha debido a la escarcha el día siguiente. Si no corría aire, había escarcha.” My father looked at the stars at night to know if he would lose the harvest due to frost the next day. If there was no wind, there would be frost.
quote_es: Mi padre miraba las estrellas de noche para saber si iba a perder la cosecha debido a la escarcha el día siguiente. Si no corría aire, había escarcha.
quote_en: My father looked at the stars at night to know if he would lose the harvest due to frost the next day. If there was no wind, there would be frost.
assumption: Atmospheric signs can indicate impending frost.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando el ganado está tranquilo y pastando y para de comer, eso indica que viene un fenómeno de la naturaleza.” When livestock are calm and grazing and stop eating, that indicates a natural phenomenon is coming.
quote_es: Cuando el ganado está tranquilo y pastando y para de comer, eso indica que viene un fenómeno de la naturaleza.
quote_en: When livestock are calm and grazing and stop eating, that indicates a natural phenomenon is coming.
assumption: Cattle behavior can serve to predict rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando las ovejas se inquietaban y amontonaban, venía la lluvia.” When the sheep became restless and huddled together, the rain was coming.
quote_es: Cuando las ovejas se inquietaban y amontonaban, venía la lluvia.
quote_en: When the sheep became restless and huddled together, the rain was coming.
assumption: Cattle behavior can serve to predict rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Muchos regantes hacen el primer riego en luna creciente porque el agua se queda más y humedece mejor la simiente.” Many irrigators do the first irrigation during the waxing moon because the water stays more and moistens the seed better.
quote_es: Muchos regantes hacen el primer riego en luna creciente porque el agua se queda más y humedece mejor la simiente.
quote_en: Many irrigators do the first irrigation during the waxing moon because the water stays more and moistens the seed better.
assumption: The lunar cycle influences soil water retention.

traditional_knowledge: ”Cuando va a llover, las hormigas salen de su nido con tierra y la ponen alrededor del hormiguero como una parada para protegerlo y que no se inunde.” When it is going to rain, ants come out of their nest with soil and place it around the anthill as a barrier to protect it from flooding.
quote_es: Cuando va a llover, las hormigas salen de su nido con tierra y la ponen alrededor del hormiguero como una parada para protegerlo y que no se inunde.
quote_en: When it is going to rain, ants come out of their nest with soil and place it around the anthill as a barrier to protect it from flooding.
assumption: Ant behavior informs on impending rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si el aire venía húmedo, era que iba a llover.” If the wind came humid, it was going to rain.
quote_es: Si el aire venía húmedo, era que iba a llover.
quote_en: If the wind came humid, it was going to rain.
assumption: Wind can inform on impending rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”La sequía hace proliferar plagas como la araña roja.” Drought causes plagues such as red spider mites to proliferate.
quote_es: La sequía hace proliferar plagas como la araña roja.
quote_en: Drought causes plagues such as red spider mites to proliferate.
assumption: Drought can bring about plagues.

traditional_knowledge: ”El sistema de previsión de las Cabañuelas sirve para predecir el tiempo del año siguiente a partir de la lluvia, las nubes etc. Se hace durante los primeros 12 días de agosto, que sirven para predecir el clima de los 12 meses del año siguiente; y los siguientes 12 días se hace al revés.” The Cabañuelas forecasting system serves to predict the weather of the following year based on rain, clouds, etc. It is done during the first 12 days of August, which serve to predict the climate for the 12 months of the following year; and the next 12 days are done in reverse.
quote_es: El sistema de previsión de las Cabañuelas sirve para predecir el tiempo del año siguiente a partir de la lluvia, las nubes etc. Se hace durante los primeros 12 días de agosto, que sirven para predecir el clima de los 12 meses del año siguiente; y los siguientes 12 días se hace al revés.
quote_en: The Cabañuelas forecasting system serves to predict the weather of the following year based on rain, clouds, etc. It is done during the first 12 days of August, which serve to predict the climate for the 12 months of the following year; and the next 12 days are done in reverse.
assumption: The climate a year from now can be predicted from current climate conditions.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si la Candelaria ’plora’, el invierno ’fora’.” If Candlemas ’cries’ (rains), winter ’goes out’ (ends).
quote_es: Si la Candelaria ’plora’, el invierno ’fora’.
quote_en: If Candlemas ’cries’ (rains), winter ’goes out’ (ends).
assumption: Rain at the beginning of February marks the end of winter.

traditional_knowledge: ”Rolde con sol moja al pastor” (Rolde es un anillo; anillo alrededor del sol). Halo around the sun wets the shepherd.
quote_es: Rolde con sol moja al pastor
quote_en: (Rolde es un anillo; anillo alrededor del sol). Halo around the sun wets the shepherd.
assumption: Changes in sunlight can help predict rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: ”La luna lleva redorde y estrellas dentro; o llueve, o corre aire o hace buen tiempo.” The moon has a halo and stars inside; either it rains, or the wind blows, or the weather is fair.
quote_es: La luna lleva redorde y estrellas dentro; o llueve, o corre aire o hace buen tiempo.
quote_en: The moon has a halo and stars inside; either it rains, or the wind blows, or the weather is fair.
assumption: Lunar phenomena can inform on weather patterns.

traditional_knowledge: ”Nublos colorá: por la tarde son de aire y por la mañana de mojá.” Red clouds: in the afternoon they bring wind, and in the morning they bring rain.
quote_es: Nublos colorá: por la tarde son de aire y por la mañana de mojá.
quote_en: Red clouds: in the afternoon they bring wind, and in the morning they bring rain.
assumption: The color and timing of clouds inform on weather patterns.

traditional_knowledge: ”Plantar arbres alternats (e.g., un pomer, un presseguer) fa que no competeixin per l’aigua.” Planting alternate trees (e.g., an apple tree, a peach tree) means they do not compete for water.
quote_es: Plantar arbres alternats (e.g., un pomer, un presseguer) fa que no competeixin per l’aigua.
quote_en: Planting alternate trees (e.g., an apple tree, a peach tree) means they do not compete for water.
assumption: Alternating different fruit trees reduces direct competition for water.

traditional_knowledge: ”Els arbres separats competeixen menys entre ells.” Separated trees compete less with each other.
quote_es: Els arbres separats competeixen menys entre ells.
quote_en: Separated trees compete less with each other.
assumption: A more dispersed spatial distribution of trees reduces inter-tree competition for water resources.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan l’arbre té fruita (al final de la producció) se li dona tota l’aigua disponible.” When the tree has fruit (at the end of production), it is given all the available water.
quote_es: Quan l’arbre té fruita (al final de la producció) se li dona tota l’aigua disponible.
quote_en: When the tree has fruit (at the end of production), it is given all the available water.
assumption: When the tree shows the fruit, it requires maximum water input.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan la fulla de l’arbre o les herbes del voltant no estan alegres has de regar més.” When the leaves of the tree or the surrounding weeds do not look happy, you have to irrigate more.
quote_es: Quan la fulla de l’arbre o les herbes del voltant no estan alegres has de regar més.
quote_en: When the leaves of the tree or the surrounding weeds do not look happy, you have to irrigate more.
assumption: Wilting or dull foliage indicates you have to irrigate more.

traditional_knowledge: ”El perer necessita més aigua que el presseguer. El pomer no necessita tanta aigua.” The pear tree needs more water than the peach tree. The apple tree does not need as much water.
quote_es: El perer necessita més aigua que el presseguer. El pomer no necessita tanta aigua.
quote_en: The pear tree needs more water than the peach tree. The apple tree does not need as much water.
assumption: Different tree species have different water needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”Després de collir es posa molta menys aigua, només per mantenir l’arbre.” After harvesting, much less water is applied, only to maintain the tree.
quote_es: Després de collir es posa molta menys aigua, només per mantenir l’arbre.
quote_en: After harvesting, much less water is applied, only to maintain the tree.
assumption: Post-harvest water needs are minimal; irrigation is only needed to maintain the fruit tree.

traditional_knowledge: ”L’arbre pot tenir fulles doblegades per la set, però quan es rega després es recuperen de cop.” The tree can have leaves bent by thirst, but when watered they recover all at once.
quote_es: L’arbre pot tenir fulles doblegades per la set, però quan es rega després es recuperen de cop.
quote_en: The tree can have leaves bent by thirst, but when watered they recover all at once.
assumption: Trees show reversible signs of water stress.

traditional_knowledge: ”Com més jove és l’arbre menys s’ha de regar.” The younger the tree, the less it needs to be watered.
quote_es: Com més jove és l’arbre menys s’ha de regar.
quote_en: The younger the tree, the less it needs to be watered.
assumption: Young trees have smaller water requirements.

traditional_knowledge: ”Per saber si l’arbre té set s’ha de visitar al migdia, no al matí, perquè al matí sempre veus l’arbre bé.” To know if the tree is thirsty, you have to visit it at midday, not in the morning, because in the morning you always see the tree well.
quote_es: Per saber si l’arbre té set s’ha de visitar al migdia, no al matí, perquè al matí sempre veus l’arbre bé.
quote_en: To know if the tree is thirsty, you have to visit it at midday, not in the morning, because in the morning you always see the tree well.
assumption: Water stress is more visible during the hottest part of the day.

traditional_knowledge: ”Les terres arenoses són més bones que les argiloses.” Sandy soils are better than clayey soils.
quote_es: Les terres arenoses són més bones que les argiloses.
quote_en: Sandy soils are better than clayey soils.
assumption: Sandy soils are better than clayey soils.

traditional_knowledge: ”La tecnologia de rec et condiciona quan plantes (rec a manta es planta a l’hivern; goteig a l’estiu).” Irrigation technology determines when you plant (with flood irrigation you plant in winter; with drip irrigation in summer).
quote_es: La tecnologia de rec et condiciona quan plantes (rec a manta es planta a l’hivern; goteig a l’estiu).
quote_en: Irrigation technology determines when you plant (with flood irrigation you plant in winter; with drip irrigation in summer).
assumption: Irrigation method influences planting season (with flood irrigation you plant in winter, with drip irrigation in summer).

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Un rec de més no fa mal a l’arbre.” An extra watering does not harm the tree.
quote_es: Un rec de més no fa mal a l’arbre.
quote_en: An extra watering does not harm the tree.
assumption: Excess watering is not harmful to fruit trees.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El migdia és quan l’arbre necessita més aigua.” Midday is when the tree needs the most water.
quote_es: El migdia és quan l’arbre necessita més aigua.
quote_en: Midday is when the tree needs the most water.
assumption: Water demand peaks at midday.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si veus bolets a la parcel·la, no cal regar tant.” If you see mushrooms in the plot, you do not need to water as much.
quote_es: Si veus bolets a la parcel·la, no cal regar tant.
quote_en: If you see mushrooms in the plot, you do not need to water as much.
assumption: Mushroom presence in the plot indicates that you do not need to irrigate that much.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”La primera i l’última regada són les més importants.” The first and last watering are the most important.
quote_es: La primera i l’última regada són les més importants.
quote_en: The first and last watering are the most important.
assumption: The first and last irrigation of the cropping season have the greatest impact on crop performance.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El rec a manta permet controlar millor les plagues de conills (la inundació inunda les madrigueres).” Flood irrigation allows better control of rabbit plagues (flooding floods the burrows).
quote_es: El rec a manta permet controlar millor les plagues de conills (la inundació inunda les madrigueres).
quote_en: Flood irrigation allows better control of rabbit plagues (flooding floods the burrows).
assumption: Flood irrigation physically disrupts pest habitats (such as rabbits).

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Amb el rec a manta els animals mengen més.” With flood irrigation, animals eat more.
quote_es: Amb el rec a manta els animals mengen més.
quote_en: With flood irrigation, animals eat more.
assumption: Flood irrigation increases food availability for animals.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El rec a manta fa més bona terra que el goter.” Flood irrigation makes better soil than drip irrigation.
quote_es: El rec a manta fa més bona terra que el goter.
quote_en: Flood irrigation makes better soil than drip irrigation.
assumption: Flood irrigation enhances soil quality.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Amb el rec a manta no es gasta més que amb el goteig perquè l’aigua torna al riu.” With flood irrigation, you do not spend more than with drip irrigation because the water returns to the river.
quote_es: Amb el rec a manta no es gasta més que amb el goteig perquè l’aigua torna al riu.
quote_en: With flood irrigation, you do not spend more than with drip irrigation because the water returns to the river.
assumption: Excess water in flood irrigation is not lost because the water ultimately returns to the river.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Amb el goteig hi ha un estalvi d’aigua.” With drip irrigation, there is water savings.
quote_es: Amb el goteig hi ha un estalvi d’aigua.
quote_en: With drip irrigation, there is water savings.
assumption: Drip irrigation saves water.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Canvi de rec a manta a goteig crearà plagues noves.” Changing from flood to drip irrigation will create new plagues.
quote_es: Canvi de rec a manta a goteig crearà plagues noves.
quote_en: Changing from flood to drip irrigation will create new plagues.
assumption: Changing from flood to drip irrigation will create new pests.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El rec a manta és un rec obsolet i té els dies comptats.” Flood irrigation is obsolete and has its days numbered.
quote_es: El rec a manta és un rec obsolet i té els dies comptats.
quote_en: Flood irrigation is obsolete and has its days numbered.
assumption: Flood irrigation is outdated and about to disappear.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El rec a manta et crea un microclima a la parcel·la, el rec a goteig no.” Flood irrigation creates a microclimate in the plot, drip irrigation does not.
quote_es: El rec a manta et crea un microclima a la parcel·la, el rec a goteig no.
quote_en: Flood irrigation creates a microclimate in the plot, drip irrigation does not.
assumption: Flood irrigation creates a microclimate in the plot, unlike drip irrigation.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Els conills i els senglars es mengen els tubs dels goteigs perquè no tenen l’aigua accessible del rec a manta.” Rabbits and wild boars eat drip irrigation tubes because they do not have the accessible water from flood irrigation.
quote_es: Els conills i els senglars es mengen els tubs dels goteigs perquè no tenen l’aigua accessible del rec a manta.
quote_en: Rabbits and wild boars eat drip irrigation tubes because they do not have the accessible water from flood irrigation.
assumption: Rabbits and wild boars damage drip irrigation systems due to lack of surface water to drink.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Per regar bé has de tenir la finca ben posada (si no tens ben fetes les vores regues més).” To irrigate well, you need to have your farm well set up (if you do not have the borders properly made, you water more).
quote_es: Per regar bé has de tenir la finca ben posada (si no tens ben fetes les vores regues més).
quote_en: To irrigate well, you need to have your farm well set up (if you do not have the borders properly made, you water more).
assumption: Proper borders on the plot reduce water loss.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Quan hi ha sequera intentem que l’aigua no marxi tan ràpid de la parcel·la cap al riu (frenem l’aigua amb pedres, herba, etc.).” When there is drought, we try to keep water from leaving the plot so quickly toward the river (we slow the water with stones, weeds, etc.).
quote_es: Quan hi ha sequera intentem que l’aigua no marxi tan ràpid de la parcel·la cap al riu (frenem l’aigua amb pedres, herba, etc.).
quote_en: When there is drought, we try to keep water from leaving the plot so quickly toward the river (we slow the water with stones, weeds, etc.).
assumption: Water retention techniques (using stones, weeds, etc.) are vital during droughts.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Els herbicides maten les herbes i fan que l’aigua marxi més ràpid de la parcel·la.” Herbicides kill weeds and make water leave the plot faster.
quote_es: Els herbicides maten les herbes i fan que l’aigua marxi més ràpid de la parcel·la.
quote_en: Herbicides kill weeds and make water leave the plot faster.
assumption: Weed killers promote surface water runoff.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”El rec de bancals alternatius separats per caballons (un sí, un no, un sí, un no) ajudava en època de sequera.” Alternating irrigation beds separated by ridges (one yes, one no, one yes, one no) helped during drought.
quote_es: El rec de bancals alternatius separats per caballons (un sí, un no, un sí, un no) ajudava en època de sequera.
quote_en: Alternating irrigation beds separated by ridges (one yes, one no, one yes, one no) helped during drought.
assumption: Alternating irrigation beds during drought helps conserve water and maintain soil moisture.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si el bancal està ben anivellat s’ha de regar menys.” If the bed is well leveled, you have to water less.
quote_es: Si el bancal està ben anivellat s’ha de regar menys.
quote_en: If the bed is well leveled, you have to water less.
assumption: Optimal leveling of the plot minimizes irrigation requirements.

domain: Irrigation practices and communal water management
traditional_knowledge: ”Si es planta al costat del canal es rega menys.” If you plant next to the canal, you water less.
quote_es: Si es planta al costat del canal es rega menys.
quote_en: If you plant next to the canal, you water less.
assumption: Crops’ proximity to water channels reduces irrigation needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”El tipus de sòl (argilós, gravós, llimós) et condiciona el cultiu i la quantitat de rec.” The soil type (clayey, gravelly, silty) determines the crop and the amount of irrigation.
quote_es: El tipus de sòl (argilós, gravós, llimós) et condiciona el cultiu i la quantitat de rec.
quote_en: The soil type (clayey, gravelly, silty) determines the crop and the amount of irrigation.
assumption: Soil texture (clayey, gravelly, silty) affects water holding capacity and crop suitability.

traditional_knowledge: ”El rec en sòls gravosos i arenosos és més llarg perquè l’aigua s’escapa.” Irrigation on gravelly and sandy soils is longer because water escapes.
quote_es: El rec en sòls gravosos i arenosos és més llarg perquè l’aigua s’escapa.
quote_en: Irrigation on gravelly and sandy soils is longer because water escapes.
assumption: Coarse soils drain faster and need prolonged watering.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si la terra no és gravosa, qualsevol terra és bona.” If the soil is not gravelly, any soil is good.
quote_es: Si la terra no és gravosa, qualsevol terra és bona.
quote_en: If the soil is not gravelly, any soil is good.
assumption: Most soils are acceptable unless they are too gravelly.

traditional_knowledge: ”Les bufoneres (forats de talps) fan regar més perquè l’aigua es xucla i es perd.” Mole holes force you to irrigate more because water gets sucked in and lost.
quote_es: Les bufoneres (forats de talps) fan regar més perquè l’aigua es xucla i es perd.
quote_en: Mole holes force you to irrigate more because water gets sucked in and lost.
assumption: Mole holes force more irrigation because water is lost through subsurface leakage.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si deixes de llaurar ja no pots llaurar mai més perquè les arrels et pugen.” If you stop plowing, you can never plow again because the roots will rise.
quote_es: Si deixes de llaurar ja no pots llaurar mai més perquè les arrels et pugen.
quote_en: If you stop plowing, you can never plow again because the roots will rise.
assumption: Tillage affects root structure and future soil management.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si hi ha aigua, la terra gravosa és la millor pel cultiu.” If there is water, gravelly soil is the best for crops.
quote_es: Si hi ha aigua, la terra gravosa és la millor pel cultiu.
quote_en: If there is water, gravelly soil is the best for crops.
assumption: Gravelly soils are ideal when water is abundant.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan segues, la capa d’herba no deixa evaporar tant l’aigua.” When you mow, the weed layer does not let water evaporate as much.
quote_es: Quan segues, la capa d’herba no deixa evaporar tant l’aigua.
quote_en: When you mow, the weed layer does not let water evaporate as much.
assumption: Weed ground cover reduces evaporation and improves moisture retention.

traditional_knowledge: ”Llaurar a l’hivern permet mantenir millor la humitat de la terra.” Plowing in winter allows better maintenance of soil moisture.
quote_es: Llaurar a l’hivern permet mantenir millor la humitat de la terra.
quote_en: Plowing in winter allows better maintenance of soil moisture.
assumption: Winter tillage conserves soil moisture.

traditional_knowledge: ”Els avis deien ’la terra calenta no es pot tocar’.” The elders said, ’hot soil cannot be touched’.
quote_es: Els avis deien ’la terra calenta no es pot tocar’.
quote_en: The elders said, ’hot soil cannot be touched’.
assumption: Summer tillage is discouraged due to high evaporation or soil damage.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si deixes herba a la parcel·la regues menys perquè preserves la humitat.” If you leave weeds in the plot, you water less because you preserve moisture.
quote_es: Si deixes herba a la parcel·la regues menys perquè preserves la humitat.
quote_en: If you leave weeds in the plot, you water less because you preserve moisture.
assumption: Vegetation in the plot retains soil moisture by limiting evaporation.

traditional_knowledge: ”La fulla de l’arbre indica molt abans que el fruit si l’arbre té set.” The leaf of the tree indicates much earlier than the fruit whether the tree is thirsty.
quote_es: La fulla de l’arbre indica molt abans que el fruit si l’arbre té set.
quote_en: The leaf of the tree indicates much earlier than the fruit whether the tree is thirsty.
assumption: Leaves show signs of water stress earlier than fruit.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan abans que es pongui el sol el veus després d’haver estat amagat, plourà durant la setmana.” When you see the sun before it sets after it had been hidden, it will rain during the week.
quote_es: Quan abans que es pongui el sol el veus després d’haver estat amagat, plourà durant la setmana.
quote_en: When you see the sun before it sets after it had been hidden, it will rain during the week.
assumption: Solar phenomena can predict imminent rainfall. Watching cloud movements and sunlight changes helps forecast coming rains.

traditional_knowledge: ”Si els núvols són més blanquinosos, més pedra.” If the clouds are more whitish, more hail.
quote_es: Si els núvols són més blanquinosos, més pedra.
quote_en: If the clouds are more whitish, more hail.
assumption: Cloud color indicates the type and severity of precipitation.

traditional_knowledge: ”Com més alts són els núvols, més pluja porten.” The higher the clouds, the more rain they bring.
quote_es: Com més alts són els núvols, més pluja porten.
quote_en: The higher the clouds, the more rain they bring.
assumption: Cloud altitude correlates with rainfall volume.

traditional_knowledge: ”Sol rogent, pluja o vent.” Reddish sun, rain or wind.
quote_es: Sol rogent, pluja o vent.
quote_en: Reddish sun, rain or wind.
assumption: Red sunrises or sunsets signal rainfall or wind changes.

traditional_knowledge: ”No només es rega pel cultiu, sinó també per matar plagues (si al gener es pot fer un rec, es fa per matar els talps que encara s’estan reproduint: els talps es mullen, surten a fora i es congelen degut al fred).” You irrigate not only for the crop but also to kill pests (if you can water in January, you do it to kill moles that are still reproducing: the moles get wet, come out, and freeze due to the cold).
quote_es: No només es rega pel cultiu, sinó també per matar plagues (si al gener es pot fer un rec, es fa per matar els talps que encara s’estan reproduint: els talps es mullen, surten a fora i es congelen degut al fred).
quote_en: You irrigate not only for the crop but also to kill pests (if you can water in January, you do it to kill moles that are still reproducing: the moles get wet, come out, and freeze due to the cold).
assumption: Irrigation can serve pest control functions.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan hi ha risc de gelades, la gent rega perquè el rec fa pujar la temperatura.” When there is risk of frost, people irrigate because watering raises the temperature.
quote_es: Quan hi ha risc de gelades, la gent rega perquè el rec fa pujar la temperatura.
quote_en: When there is risk of frost, people irrigate because watering raises the temperature.
assumption: Under risk of frost, watering can raise local temperatures and prevent frost damage.

traditional_knowledge: ”Les tempestes són diferents després d’haver posat el goter.” Storms are different after drip irrigation has been installed.
quote_es: Les tempestes són diferents després d’haver posat el goter.
quote_en: Storms are different after drip irrigation has been installed.
assumption: Irrigation methods affect local microclimates and storm behavior.

traditional_knowledge: ”Les orenetes volen més baixes quan ha de ploure.” Swallows fly lower when it is going to rain.
quote_es: Les orenetes volen més baixes quan ha de ploure.
quote_en: Swallows fly lower when it is going to rain.
assumption: Bird behavior is an indicator of impending rain.

traditional_knowledge: ”Abans de ploure fa molta xafogor.” Before rain, it is very humid.
quote_es: Abans de ploure fa molta xafogor.
quote_en: Before rain, it is very humid.
assumption: Increased humidity precedes rainfall.

traditional_knowledge: ”Per molt que plogui s’ha de regar igual.” No matter how much it rains, you have to water the same.
quote_es: Per molt que plogui s’ha de regar igual.
quote_en: No matter how much it rains, you have to water the same.
assumption: You have to irrigate regardless of rainfall patterns.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan plou no regues tant.” When it rains, you do not water as much.
quote_es: Quan plou no regues tant.
quote_en: When it rains, you do not water as much.
assumption: Rainfall reduces irrigation needs.

traditional_knowledge: ”Les garses noten quan venen pedregades perquè tapen el seu niu amb branques per damunt.” Magpies notice when hailstorms are coming because they cover their nests with branches on top.
quote_es: Les garses noten quan venen pedregades perquè tapen el seu niu amb branques per damunt.
quote_en: Magpies notice when hailstorms are coming because they cover their nests with branches on top.
assumption: Bird behavior can forecast hail.

traditional_knowledge: ”Quan ha de ploure alguns ocells de terra es posen a les branques.” When it is about to rain, some ground birds perch on branches.
quote_es: Quan ha de ploure alguns ocells de terra es posen a les branques.
quote_en: When it is about to rain, some ground birds perch on branches.
assumption: Ground birds moving to trees before rain indicates weather change.

traditional_knowledge: ”Amb el rec a manta es rega igual quan hi ha abundància d’aigua que quan hi ha sequera.” With flood irrigation, you water the same when there is water abundance as when there is drought.
quote_es: Amb el rec a manta es rega igual quan hi ha abundància d’aigua que quan hi ha sequera.
quote_en: With flood irrigation, you water the same when there is water abundance as when there is drought.
assumption: Flood irrigation practices are not adjusted for water scarcity.

traditional_knowledge: ”En el rec, el clima et condiciona més que la terra.” In irrigation, climate conditions you more than the soil.
quote_es: En el rec, el clima et condiciona més que la terra.
quote_en: In irrigation, climate conditions you more than the soil.
assumption: Weather has a stronger impact on irrigation decisions than soil type.
